## 183. člen

(1)	Kdor proizvaja, pripravlja, izdeluje, prodaja ali ponuja naprodaj ali zaradi prodaje ali dajanja v promet kupuje ali hrani, ali posreduje pri prodaji ali nakupu, uvaža ali izvaža, vnaša ali iznaša ali kako drugače daje v promet zdravila, zdravilne učinkovine, pomožne snovi, medicinske pripomočke ali njihove dele ali dodatke ali druga sredstva za zdravljenje, ki so škodljiva za zdravje, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor pridobiva, pripravlja, izdeluje, predeluje, prodaja ali ponuja naprodaj ali zaradi prodaje ali dajanja v promet kupuje ali hrani, ali posreduje pri prodaji ali nakupu, uvaža ali izvaža, vnaša ali iznaša ali kako drugače daje v promet okuženo kri ali drugo tkivo ali iz tega izdelano snov za zdravljenje.
(3)	Kdor stori dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena iz malomarnosti, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.

(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico hudo ali posebno hudo telesno poškodbo ali temu ustrezno okvaro zdravja ene ali več oseb, ali če dejanje stori oseba, ki je zlorabila dano zaupanje, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena z zaporom od enega do desetih let, za dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka pa z zaporom do petih let.
(5)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka z zaporom od dveh do petnajstih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka pa z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(6)	Škodljiva zdravila, zdravilne učinkovine, pomožne snovi, medicinski pripomočki, njihovi deli, dodatki ali druga sredstva za zdravljenje, okužena kri, drugo tkivo ali iz tega izdelana snov za zdravljenje se vzamejo.

Proizvodnja in promet ponarejenih sredstev za zdravljenje, zdravil, ki nimajo
dovoljenja za promet, ali medicinskih pripomočkov, ki ne izpolnjujejo zahtev glede skladnosti

183.a	člen
(1)	Kdor proizvaja, pripravlja, izdeluje, prodaja ali ponuja naprodaj ali zaradi prodaje ali dajanja v promet kupuje ali hrani, ali posreduje pri prodaji ali nakupu, uvaža ali izvaža, vnaša ali iznaša ali kako drugače daje v promet zdravila, zdravilne učinkovine, pomožne snovi, medicinske pripomočke ali njihove dele ali dodatke ali druga sredstva za zdravljenje, ki so ponarejena, in ni podano hujše kaznivo dejanje po tem zakoniku, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor stori dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka z zdravili, ki nimajo dovoljenja za promet, ali z medicinskimi pripomočki, ki ne izpolnjujejo zahtev glede skladnosti.
(3)	Če stori dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena oseba, ki je zlorabila dano zaupanje, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do petih let.
(4)	Zdravila, zdravilne učinkovine, pomožne snovi, medicinski pripomočki, njihovi deli, dodatki ali druga sredstva za zdravljenje iz prvega in drugega odstavka tega člena se vzamejo.

Proizvodnja in promet zdravju škodljivih živil in drugih izdelkov

## 184. člen

(1)	Kdor proizvaja, prodaja ali kako drugače daje v promet živila, ki so škodljiva za zdravje ljudi, in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje ali zdravje ljudi, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor proizvaja, prodaja ali kako drugače daje v promet sredstva za osebno nego, otroške igrače ali podobne izdelke za množično potrošnjo, ki so škodljivi za zdravje.

(3)	Kdor stori dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena iz malomarnosti, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico hudo ali posebno hudo telesno poškodbo ali temu ustrezno okvaro zdravja ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka z zaporom do osmih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka pa z zaporom do petih let.
(5)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka pa z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(6)	Škodljiva živila in drugi izdelki se vzamejo.

Nevestno pregledovanje mesa za prehrano

## 185. člen

(1)	Veterinar ali druga pooblaščena oseba, ki pri pregledu klavnih živali ali mesa, ki je namenjeno za prehrano, nevestno ravna ali kljub predpisom ne opravi pregleda in s tem omogoči, da pride v promet meso, ki je škodljivo za človekovo zdravje, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Če je dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do šestih mesecev.

Neupravičena proizvodnja in promet s prepovedanimi drogami, nedovoljenimi snovmi in postopki v športu ter predhodnimi sestavinami za izdelavo prepovedanih drog

## 186. člen

(1)	Kdor neupravičeno proizvaja, predeluje, prodaja ali ponuja naprodaj ali zaradi prodaje ali dajanja v promet kupuje, hrani ali prenaša ali posreduje pri prodaji ali nakupu ali kako drugače neupravičeno daje v promet rastline ali substance, ki so razvrščene kot prepovedane droge ali nedovoljene snovi v športu, ali predhodne sestavine, ki se uporabljajo za izdelavo prepovedanih drog, ali sredstva ali sestavine, ki se uporabljajo za postopke, ki so razvrščeni kot nedovoljeni v športu, ali postopke, ki so razvrščeni kot nedovoljeni v športu, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(2)	Kdor prodaja, ponuja na prodaj ali brezplačno deli prepovedano drogo, ali nedovoljeno snov v športu, ali predhodno sestavino za izdelavo prepovedanih drog, ali kdor prodaja, ponuja ali izvaja nedovoljene postopke v športu mladoletni osebi, duševno bolni osebi, osebi z začasno duševno motnjo, hujšo duševno zaostalostjo ali osebi, ki je v postopku odvajanja od odvisnosti ali rehabilitacije ali če stori dejanje v vzgojnih ali izobraževalnih ustanovah ali v njihovi neposredni bližini, v zaporih, v vojaških enotah, v javnih lokalih ali na javnih prireditvah, ali stori dejanje iz prvega odstavka javni uslužbenec, duhovnik, zdravnik, socialni delavec, učitelj ali vzgojitelj in pri tem izkorišča svoj položaj ali kdor za izvrševanje omenjenega dejanja uporablja mladoletne osebe se kaznuje z zaporom od treh do petnajst let.

(3)	Če je dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka storjeno v hudodelski združbi za izvedbo takih dejanj, ali če je storilec tega dejanja organiziral mrežo prekupčevalcev ali posrednikov, se kaznuje z zaporom od petih do petnajstih let.
(4)	Kdor brez pooblastila izdeluje, nabavlja, ima ali daje v uporabo opremo, snovi ali predhodne sestavine, za katere ve, da so namenjene za izdelavo prepovedanih drog ali nedovoljenih snovi v športu ali za uporabo nedovoljenih postopkov v športu, se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do petih let.
(5)	Prepovedane droge, nedovoljene snovi v športu, sredstva ali sestavine, ki omogočajo uporabo nedovoljenih postopkov v športu, in sredstva za njihovo izdelovanje se vzamejo. Prevozna sredstva, uporabljena za prevoz in hrambo drog, nedovoljenih snovi v športu ali sredstev, ki omogočajo uporabo nedovoljenih postopkov v športu, se odvzamejo, če imajo za prevoz in hrambo drog ali nedovoljenih snovi in postopkov v športu posebej prirejene prostore ali če je njihov lastnik vedel ali bi bil mogel vedeti, da bodo uporabljena za tak namen.

Omogočanje uživanja ali uporabe prepovedanih drog ali nedovoljenih snovi ali postopkov v športu
translated_text:
## 183. člen

(1)	Whoever manufactures, prepares, produces, sells or offers for sale or for the purpose of sale or placing on the market purchases or stores, or intermediates in the sale or purchase, imports or exports, brings in or takes out or in any other way places on the market medicines, medicinal substances, auxiliary substances, medical devices or their parts or accessories or other means of treatment that are harmful to health, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever acquires, prepares, produces, processes, sells or offers for sale or for the purpose of sale or placing on the market purchases or stores, or intermediates in the sale or purchase, imports or exports, brings in or takes out or in any other way places on the market infected blood or other tissue or a substance for treatment made therefrom.
(3)	Whoever commits the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Article through negligence shall be punished by imprisonment of up to one year.

(4)	If the act referred to in the first, second or third paragraph of this Article results in serious or particularly serious bodily injury or corresponding impairment of health of one or more persons, or if the act is committed by a person who has abused trust given to them, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Article by imprisonment from one to ten years, and for the act referred to in the preceding paragraph by imprisonment of up to five years.
(5)	If the act referred to in the first, second or third paragraph of this Article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first or second paragraph by imprisonment from two to fifteen years, and for the act referred to in the third paragraph by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(6)	Harmful medicines, medicinal substances, auxiliary substances, medical devices, their parts, accessories or other means of treatment, infected blood, other tissue or a substance for treatment made therefrom shall be seized.

Proizvodnja in promet ponarejenih sredstev za zdravljenje, zdravil, ki nimajo
dovoljenja za promet, ali medicinskih pripomočkov, ki ne izpolnjujejo zahtev glede skladnosti

183.a	člen
(1)	Whoever manufactures, prepares, produces, sells or offers for sale or for the purpose of sale or placing on the market purchases or stores, or intermediates in the sale or purchase, imports or exports, brings in or takes out or in any other way places on the market medicines, medicinal substances, auxiliary substances, medical devices or their parts or accessories or other means of treatment that are counterfeit, and a more serious criminal offence under this Code is not established, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever commits the act referred to in the preceding paragraph with medicines that do not have marketing authorisation, or with medical devices that do not meet conformity requirements.
(3)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Article is committed by a person who has abused trust given to them, they shall be punished by imprisonment from one to five years.
(4)	Medicines, medicinal substances, auxiliary substances, medical devices, their parts, accessories or other means of treatment referred to in the first and second paragraphs of this Article shall be seized.

Proizvodnja in promet zdravju škodljivih živil in drugih izdelkov

## 184. člen

(1)	Whoever manufactures, sells or in any other way places on the market foodstuffs that are harmful to human health, and thereby causes danger to the life or health of people, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever manufactures, sells or in any other way places on the market personal care products, children's toys or similar products for mass consumption that are harmful to health.

(3)	Whoever commits the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Article through negligence shall be punished by imprisonment of up to one year.
(4)	If the act referred to in the first, second or third paragraph of this Article results in serious or particularly serious bodily injury or corresponding impairment of health of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first or second paragraph by imprisonment of up to eight years, and for the act referred to in the third paragraph by imprisonment of up to five years.
(5)	If the act referred to in the first, second or third paragraph of this Article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first or second paragraph by imprisonment from one to twelve years, and for the act referred to in the third paragraph by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(6)	Harmful foodstuffs and other products shall be seized.

Nevestno pregledovanje mesa za prehrano

## 185. člen

(1)	A veterinarian or other authorised person who acts unconscientiously in the inspection of slaughter animals or meat intended for consumption, or fails to carry out the inspection despite regulations and thereby enables meat that is harmful to human health to be placed on the market, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to one year.
(2)	If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph is committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to six months.

Neupravičena proizvodnja in promet s prepovedanimi drogami, nedovoljenimi snovmi in postopki v športu ter predhodnimi sestavinami za izdelavo prepovedanih drog

## 186. člen

(1)	Whoever unlawfully manufactures, processes, sells or offers for sale or for the purpose of sale or placing on the market purchases, stores or transports or intermediates in the sale or purchase or in any other way unlawfully places on the market plants or substances that are classified as prohibited drugs or prohibited substances in sport, or precursors used for the manufacture of prohibited drugs, or agents or components used for procedures that are classified as prohibited in sport, or procedures that are classified as prohibited in sport, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(2)	Whoever sells, offers for sale or distributes free of charge a prohibited drug, or a prohibited substance in sport, or a precursor for the manufacture of prohibited drugs, or whoever sells, offers or carries out prohibited procedures in sport to a minor, a mentally ill person, a person with a temporary mental disorder, severe mental retardation or a person undergoing withdrawal from addiction or rehabilitation, or if the act is committed in educational or training institutions or in their immediate vicinity, in prisons, in military units, in public premises or at public events, or the act referred to in the first paragraph is committed by a public official, priest, doctor, social worker, teacher or educator and in doing so exploits their position, or whoever uses minors to carry out the said act, shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.

(3)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph is committed in a criminal organisation for carrying out such acts, or if the perpetrator of this act has organised a network of traffickers or intermediaries, they shall be punished by imprisonment from five to fifteen years.
(4)	Whoever without authorisation manufactures, procures, possesses or makes available for use equipment, substances or precursors, knowing that they are intended for the manufacture of prohibited drugs or prohibited substances in sport or for the use of prohibited procedures in sport, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(5)	Prohibited drugs, prohibited substances in sport, agents or components that enable the use of prohibited procedures in sport, and means for their manufacture shall be seized. Means of transport used for the transport and storage of drugs, prohibited substances in sport or agents that enable the use of prohibited procedures in sport shall be confiscated if they have specially adapted spaces for the transport and storage of drugs or prohibited substances and procedures in sport, or if their owner knew or could have known that they would be used for such purpose.

Omogočanje uživanja ali uporabe prepovedanih drog ali nedovoljenih snovi ali postopkov v športu

## 187. člen

(1)	Kdor napelje drugega k uživanju prepovedanih drog ali nedovoljenih snovi v športu ali k uporabi nedovoljenih postopkov v športu ali mu jih da, da jih uživa ali uporabi on ali kdo drug, ali kdor da na razpolago prostore za uživanje ali uporabo prepovedanih drog, nedovoljenih snovi ali postopkov v športu ali kako drugače omogoči drugemu, da uživa ali uporabi prepovedane droge, nedovoljene snovi ali postopke v športu, se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do osmih let.
(2)	Kdor stori dejanje iz prvega odstavka proti več osebam, proti mladoletni osebi, duševno bolni osebi, osebi z začasno duševno motnjo, hujšo duševno zaostalostjo ali osebi, ki je v postopku odvajanja od odvisnosti ali rehabilitacije ali če stori dejanje v vzgojnih ali izobraževalnih ustanovah ali v njihovi neposredni bližini, v zaporih, v vojaških enotah, v javnih lokalih ali na javnih prireditvah, ali stori dejanje iz prvega odstavka javni uslužbenec, duhovnik, zdravnik, socialni delavec, učitelj ali vzgojitelj in pri tem izkorišča svoj položaj, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let.
(3)	Prepovedane droge, nedovoljene snovi v športu in pripomočki za njihovo uživanje ter sredstva in sestavine, ki omogočajo uporabo nedovoljenih postopkov v športu, se vzamejo.
(4)	Dejanje iz prvega in drugega odstavka tega člena ni protipravno, če storilec ravna po programu zdravljenja odvisnosti ali nadzorovane uporabe droge, ki je v skladu z zakonom potrjen in se izvaja v okviru ali pod nadzorom javnega zdravstva.

Enaindvajseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER ZAKONSKO ZVEZO, DRUŽINO IN OTROKE

Dvojna zakonska zveza

## 188. člen

(1)	Kdor sklene novo zakonsko zvezo, čeprav je že poročen, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje tudi, kdor sklene zakonsko zvezo z osebo, za katero ve, da je poročena.
(3)	Če je prejšnja zakonska zveza prenehala ali je bila razveljavljena, se pregon ne začne, če pa se je začel, se ustavi.

Sprememba rodbinskega stanja

## 189. člen

Kdor podtakne ali zamenja otroka ali kako drugače spremeni njegovo rodbinsko stanje, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Odvzem mladoletne osebe

## 190. člen

(1)	Kdor protipravno odvzame mladoletno osebo roditelju, posvojitelju, skrbniku, zavodu ali osebi, ki ji je zaupana, ali jo zadržuje in preprečuje, da bi jo imel tisti, ki ima pravico do nje, ali kdor zlonamerno onemogoča, da bi se uresničila izvršljiva odločba glede mladoletne osebe, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	V primeru, da je dejanje povzročilo poslabšanje duševnega ali telesnega zdravja mladoletne osebe ali da je ogrozilo njen razvoj, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do petih let.
(3)	Če izreče sodišče pogojno obsodbo, lahko naloži storilcu, da mora mladoletno osebo izročiti upravičencu ali omogočiti uresničitev izvršljive odločbe glede mladoletne osebe.
(4)	Če je storilec dejanja iz prvega odstavka tega člena prostovoljno izročil mladoletno osebo upravičencu ali omogočil uresničitev izvršljive odločbe, se mu kazen lahko odpusti.

Nasilje v družini

## 191. člen

(1)	Kdor v družinski skupnosti z drugim grdo ravna, ga pretepa ali drugače boleče ali ponižujoče ravna, ga z grožnjo z neposrednim napadom na življenje ali telo preganja iz skupnega prebivališča ali mu omejuje svobodo gibanja, ga zalezuje, ga prisiljuje k delu ali opuščanju dela ali ga kako drugače z nasilnim omejevanjem njegovih enakih pravic spravlja v skupnosti v podrejen položaj, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor stori dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka v kakšni drugi trajnejši življenjski skupnosti.

(3)	Če je dejanje iz prvega odstavka storjeno proti osebi, s katero je storilec živel v družinski ali drugi trajnejši skupnosti, ki je razpadla, je pa dejanje s to skupnostjo povezano, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Zanemarjanje mladoletne osebe in surovo ravnanje

## 192. člen

(1)	Starši, skrbnik, rejnik ali druga oseba, ki hudo krši svoje dolžnosti do mladoletne osebe, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Starši, skrbnik, rejnik ali druga oseba, ki sili mladoletno osebo k pretiranemu delu ali k delu, ki ni primerno njeni starosti ali k opuščanju dela, ali jo iz koristoljubnosti navaja k beračenju ali drugim dejanjem, ki so škodljiva za njen razvoj, ali z njo surovo ravna ali jo trpinči, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.

Kršitev družinskih obveznosti

## 193. člen

(1)	Kdor hudo zanemarja družinske obveznosti, ki jih ima po zakonu, in tako pusti v težkem položaju družinskega člana, ki ne more sam skrbeti zase, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Če sodišče izreče pogojno obsodbo, lahko naloži storilcu, da mora redno izpolnjevati svoje dolžnosti skrbi, vzgoje in preživljanja.

Neplačevanje preživnine

## 194. člen

(1)	Kdor ne daje preživnine za osebo, ki jo po zakonu mora preživljati in za katero je višina njegove preživninske obveznosti določena z izvršilnim naslovom, čeprav bi to zmogel, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Če je zaradi dejanja iz prejšnjega odstavka ogroženo ali bi lahko bilo ogroženo preživljanje upravičenca ali če se storilec izmika dajati preživnino, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(3)	Če sodišče izreče pogojno obsodbo, lahko naloži storilcu dejanja iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena, da mora redno plačevati preživnino, lahko pa tudi, da mora poravnati zaostalo preživnino ali druge prisojene obveznosti, nastale s preživljanjem.

Krvoskrunstvo

## 195. člen

Oseba, ki spolno občuje z mladoletnim krvnim sorodnikom v ravni črti ali z mladoletnim bratom oziroma sestro, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.

Dvaindvajseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER DELOVNO RAZMERJE IN SOCIALNO VARNOST

Kršitev temeljnih pravic delavcev

## 196. člen

(1)	Kdor ne ravna po predpisih o sklenitvi pogodbe o zaposlitvi in o prenehanju delovnega razmerja, plači in drugih prejemkih iz delovnega razmerja, delovnem času, odmoru, počitku, letnem dopustu ali odsotnosti z dela, varstvu žensk, mladine in invalidov, varstvu delavcev zaradi nosečnosti in starševstva, varstva starejših delavcev, prepovedi nadurnega ali nočnega dela ali plačilu predpisanih prispevkov in tako prikrajša enega ali več delavcev ali iskalcev zaposlitve za pravice, ki jim pripadajo, ali jim jih omeji, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let in denarno kaznijo.
(2)	Če so bile z dejanjem iz prejšnjega odstavka kršene pravice najmanj dvajsetih delavcev ali če so enemu ali več delavcem kršene pravice v obdobju najmanj dveh let, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let in denarno kaznijo.
(3)	S kaznijo iz prvega odstavka tega člena se kaznuje, kdor pogojuje sklenitev pogodbe o zaposlitvi s tem, da delavka med zaposlitvijo ne bo zanosila ali rodila otroka ali od delavke med zaposlitvijo zahteva izjavo, da bo v takem primeru dala odpoved delovnega razmerja ali sprejela sporazumno prenehanje delovnega razmerja.

Šikaniranje na delovnem mestu

## 197. člen

(1)	Kdor na delovnem mestu ali v zvezi z delom s spolnim nadlegovanjem, psihičnim nasiljem, trpinčenjem ali neenakopravnim obravnavanjem povzroči drugemu zaposlenemu ponižanje ali prestrašenost, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Če ima dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka za posledico psihično, psihosomatsko ali fizično obolenje ali zmanjšanje delovne storilnosti zaposlenega, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Kršitev pravic pri zaposlovanju ali brezposelnosti

## 198. člen

(1)	Kdor komu odreče ali omeji pravico do svobodne zaposlitve pod takimi pogoji, kot so določeni s predpisi, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor zavestno ne ravna po predpisih o pravicah brezposelnih oseb in tako brezposelno osebo prikrajša za pravico, ki ji pripada ali ji jo omeji.

Zaposlovanje na črno
translated_text:
## 187. člen

(1)	Whoever incites another to use prohibited drugs or prohibited substances in sport or to use prohibited procedures in sport, or gives them to be used by that person or another, or whoever makes premises available for the use of prohibited drugs, prohibited substances or procedures in sport, or in any other way enables another to use prohibited drugs, prohibited substances or procedures in sport, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to eight years.
(2)	Whoever commits the act from the first paragraph against several persons, against a minor, a mentally ill person, a person with a temporary mental disorder, severe mental retardation or a person undergoing withdrawal from addiction or rehabilitation, or if the act is committed in educational or training institutions or in their immediate vicinity, in prisons, in military units, in public premises or at public events, or commits the act from the first paragraph as a public official, priest, doctor, social worker, teacher or educator and thereby exploits their position, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eleven years.
(3)	Prohibited drugs, prohibited substances in sport and accessories for their use, as well as means and components enabling the use of prohibited procedures in sport, shall be confiscated.
(4)	The act from the first and second paragraphs of this article is not unlawful if the perpetrator acts under a programme of addiction treatment or supervised drug use that is approved in accordance with the law and is implemented within or under the supervision of public health services.

Enaindvajseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER ZAKONSKO ZVEZO, DRUŽINO IN OTROKE

Dvojna zakonska zveza

## 188. člen

(1)	Whoever enters into a new marriage although already married shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever enters into marriage with a person knowing that person to be married.
(3)	If the previous marriage has ceased or has been annulled, prosecution shall not be commenced, or if it has been commenced, it shall be discontinued.

Sprememba rodbinskega stanja

## 189. člen

Whoever substitutes or exchanges a child or in any other way changes their family status shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.

Odvzem mladoletne osebe

## 190. člen

(1)	Whoever unlawfully takes a minor from a parent, adoptive parent, guardian, institution or person to whom the minor has been entrusted, or detains the minor and prevents the person entitled to the minor from having them, or whoever maliciously prevents the enforcement of an enforceable decision concerning a minor, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(2)	If the act has caused deterioration of the minor's mental or physical health or has endangered their development, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to five years.
(3)	If the court imposes a suspended sentence, it may order the perpetrator to hand over the minor to the entitled person or to enable the enforcement of the enforceable decision concerning the minor.
(4)	If the perpetrator of the act from the first paragraph of this article has voluntarily handed over the minor to the entitled person or has enabled the enforcement of the enforceable decision, the punishment may be remitted.

Nasilje v družini

## 191. člen

(1)	Whoever in a family community treats another rudely, beats them or otherwise treats them painfully or humiliatingly, drives them from the common residence by threatening an immediate attack on life or body or restricts their freedom of movement, stalks them, forces them to work or to refrain from work, or in any other way by violently restricting their equal rights places them in a subordinate position in the community, shall be punished by imprisonment up to five years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever commits the act from the preceding paragraph in any other permanent cohabitation community.

(3)	If the act from the first paragraph is committed against a person with whom the perpetrator lived in a family or other permanent community that has dissolved, but the act is connected with that community, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.

Zanemarjanje mladoletne osebe in surovo ravnanje

## 192. člen

(1)	Parents, a guardian, foster parent or other person who seriously violates their duties towards a minor shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
(2)	Parents, a guardian, foster parent or other person who forces a minor to excessive work or to work not appropriate to their age or to refrain from work, or out of self-interest induces them to begging or other acts harmful to their development, or treats them cruelly or torments them, shall be punished by imprisonment up to five years.

Kršitev družinskih obveznosti

## 193. člen

(1)	Whoever seriously neglects family obligations they have under the law and thereby leaves a family member who cannot care for themselves in a difficult situation shall be punished by imprisonment up to two years.
(2)	If the court imposes a suspended sentence, it may order the perpetrator to regularly fulfil their duties of care, upbringing and maintenance.

Neplačevanje preživnine

## 194. člen

(1)	Whoever does not provide maintenance for a person they are obliged to maintain under the law and for whom the amount of their maintenance obligation is determined by an enforcement title, although they would be able to do so, shall be punished by imprisonment up to one year.
(2)	If due to the act from the preceding paragraph the maintenance of the beneficiary is endangered or could be endangered, or if the perpetrator evades providing maintenance, they shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
(3)	If the court imposes a suspended sentence, it may order the perpetrator of the act from the first or second paragraph of this article to regularly pay maintenance, and may also order them to settle maintenance arrears or other awarded obligations arising from maintenance.

Krvoskrunstvo

## 195. člen

A person who has sexual intercourse with a minor blood relative in the direct line or with a minor brother or sister shall be punished by imprisonment up to two years.

Dvaindvajseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER DELOVNO RAZMERJE IN SOCIALNO VARNOST

Kršitev temeljnih pravic delavcev

## 196. člen

(1)	Whoever does not act in accordance with regulations on the conclusion of employment contracts and on the termination of employment, wages and other earnings from employment, working time, breaks, rest, annual leave or absence from work, protection of women, youth and disabled persons, protection of workers due to pregnancy and parenthood, protection of older workers, prohibition of overtime or night work, or payment of prescribed contributions, and thereby deprives one or more workers or jobseekers of rights to which they are entitled or restricts those rights, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years and a fine.
(2)	If by the act from the preceding paragraph the rights of at least twenty workers have been violated, or if the rights of one or more workers have been violated over a period of at least two years, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment up to five years and a fine.
(3)	The punishment from the first paragraph of this article shall apply to whoever makes the conclusion of an employment contract conditional on a female worker not becoming pregnant or giving birth to a child during employment, or requires from a female worker during employment a statement that in such a case she will resign from employment or accept termination of employment by mutual agreement.

Šikaniranje na delovnem mestu

## 197. člen

(1)	Whoever at the workplace or in connection with work, by sexual harassment, psychological violence, bullying or unequal treatment, causes humiliation or intimidation to another employee, shall be punished by imprisonment up to two years.
(2)	If the act from the preceding paragraph results in psychological, psychosomatic or physical illness or reduction of the employee's work performance, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.

Kršitev pravic pri zaposlovanju ali brezposelnosti

## 198. člen

(1)	Whoever denies or restricts someone's right to free employment under conditions as determined by regulations shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever knowingly does not act in accordance with regulations on the rights of unemployed persons and thereby deprives an unemployed person of a right to which they are entitled or restricts that right.

Zaposlovanje na črno

heading_path: Opozorilo: Neuradno prečiščeno besedilo predpisa predstavlja zgolj informativni delovni pripomoček, glede katerega organ ne jamči odškodninsko ali kako drugače.
text:
## 199. člen

(1)	Kdor v nasprotju s predpisi zaposli dva ali več delavcev in jih ne prijavi za ustrezno zavarovanje ali zaposli dva ali več tujcev ali oseb brez državljanstva brez ustreznih dovoljenj za delo, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Kdor zaporedoma ali trajneje ali v znatnem številu zaposluje tujce, ki niso državljani države članice Evropske unije in nezakonito prebivajo na ozemlju Republike Slovenije, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(3)	Če je dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena storjeno z zaposlitvijo delavcev, ki niso usposobljeni za izvajanje del s posebnimi pooblastili ali s pravico poseganja v telesno ali duševno celovitost posameznika ali pod posebej izkoriščevalskimi delovnimi pogoji ali z izkoriščanjem žrtve trgovine z ljudmi ali z zaposlitvijo mladoletne osebe, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Kršitev pravic do sodelovanja pri upravljanju in kršitev sindikalnih pravic

## 200. člen

(1)	Kdor s kršitvijo predpisov ali splošnih aktov prepreči ali onemogoči delavcem uresničevanje pravic do sodelovanja pri upravljanju ali te pravice zlorabi ali ovira njihovo uresničevanje, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor s kršitvijo predpisov ali splošnih aktov prepreči ali onemogoči delavcem svobodno združevanje in sindikalne dejavnosti ali ovira uresničevanje sindikalnih pravic ali prevzame sindikat.

Ogrožanje varnosti pri delu

## 201. člen

(1)	Kdor v rudniku, tovarni, na gradbišču ali kakšnem drugem delovnem kraju uniči, poškoduje ali odstrani varnostne naprave in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje ljudi, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Oseba, ki je odgovorna za varnost in zdravje pri delu v rudnikih, tovarnah, delavnicah, na gradbiščih ali drugih delovnih krajih in ne postavi varnostnih naprav ali ne skrbi za njihovo brezhibnost ali ne poskrbi za njihovo delovanje, kadar je potrebno, ali sicer ne ravna po predpisih ali tehničnih pravilih o varnostnih ukrepih in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje ljudi, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(3)	Če je dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ene ali več oseb, se storilec za dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena kaznuje z zaporom do petih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka pa z zaporom do treh let.

(5)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec za dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka pa z zaporom od enega do osmih let.

Kršitev pravic iz socialnega zavarovanja

## 202. člen

Kdor ne ravna po predpisih o socialnem zavarovanju in s tem koga prikrajša za pravico, ki mu pripada, ali mu jo omeji, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

Zloraba pravic iz socialnega zavarovanja

## 203. člen

(1)	Kdor hlini ali si povzroči bolezen ali delovno nezmožnost in s tem doseže, da se mu na podlagi socialnega zavarovanja prizna pravica, ki mu ne bi pripadala, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Kdor pristojnemu organu predloži lažne listine ali da lažno izjavo in ga s tem preslepi, da izda odločbo o pokojnini, invalidnini ali denarnem socialnem dodatku, čeprav niso dani pogoji za izdajo take odločbe, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.

Triindvajseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER PREMOŽENJE

Tatvina

## 204. člen

(1)	Kdor vzame komu tujo premično stvar, da bi si jo protipravno prilastil, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Če je vrednost ukradene stvari majhna in si je storilec hotel prilastiti stvar take vrednosti, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(3)	Pregon za dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka se začne na predlog.
(4)	Če je storilec vrnil oškodovancu ukradeno stvar, preden je zvedel, da je uveden kazenski postopek, se mu sme kazen odpustiti.

Velika tatvina

## 205. člen

(1)	Storilec tatvine iz prvega odstavka prejšnjega člena se kaznuje z zaporom do
petih let:
1)	če je storil tatvino tako, da je z vlomom, vdorom ali drugačnim premagovanjem večjih ovir prišel v zaprto stavbo, sobo, blagajno, omaro ali druge zaprte prostore;
2)	če sta storili tatvino dve ali več oseb, ki so se združile zato, da bi kradle;
3)	če je storil tatvino na posebno predrzen način;
4)	če je imel pri sebi kakšno orožje ali nevarno orodje za napad ali obrambo;
5)	če je storil tatvino ob požaru, povodnji ali podobni naravni nesreči;
6)	če je storil tatvino tako, da je izrabil nemoč ali nesrečo drugega.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje storilec tatvine, če je ukradena stvar posebnega kulturnega pomena ali naravna vrednota ali če je ukradena stvar velike vrednosti in si je storilec hotel prilastiti tako stvar ali stvar take vrednosti.
(3)	Če je bila z dejanjem iz prvega odstavka tega člena pridobljena stvar posebnega kulturnega pomena ali stvar velike vrednosti in si je storilec hotel prilastiti tako stvar ali stvar take vrednosti ali če je bilo dejanje iz drugega odstavka tega člena storjeno v hudodelski združbi, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.

Rop

## 206. člen

(1)	Kdor vzame tujo premično stvar, da bi si jo protipravno prilastil, tako da uporabi silo zoper kakšno osebo ali ji zagrozi z neposrednim napadom na življenje ali telo, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(2)	Če sta storili rop dve ali več oseb, ki so se združile zato, da bi ropale, ali če je vrednost ukradene stvari velika in si je storilec hotel prilastiti stvar take vrednosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od treh do petnajstih let.
(3)	Če je bilo dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena storjeno v hudodelski združbi, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od petih do petnajstih let.

Roparska tatvina

## 207. člen

(1)	Kdor je zaloten pri tatvini, pa zato, da bi ukradeno stvar obdržal, uporabi proti komu silo ali mu zagrozi z neposrednim napadom na življenje ali telo, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(2)	Če je vrednost ukradene stvari velika in si je storilec hotel prilastiti stvar take vrednosti, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh do petnajstih let.

Zatajitev

## 208. člen

(1)	Kdor si protipravno prilasti tujo premično stvar, ki mu je zaupana, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Če je vrednost zatajene stvari majhna in si je storilec hotel prilastiti stvar take vrednosti, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do šestih mesecev.
(3)	Če stori dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena skrbnik, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(4)	Če je zatajena stvar posebnega kulturnega pomena ali naravna vrednota ali če je zatajena stvar velike vrednosti in si je storilec hotel prilastiti tako stvar ali stvar take vrednosti, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(5)	Kdor si protipravno prilasti tujo premično stvar, ki jo je našel ali je do nje po naključju prišel, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(6)	Pregon za dejanje iz prvega, drugega in petega odstavka tega člena se začne na predlog.

Poneverba in neupravičena uporaba tujega premoženja
translated_text:
## 199. člen

(1)	Whoever, contrary to regulations, employs two or more workers and fails to register them for appropriate insurance or employs two or more foreigners or stateless persons without appropriate work permits, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.
(2)	Whoever consecutively or continuously or in substantial numbers employs foreigners who are not citizens of a member state of the European Union and are illegally residing on the territory of the Republic of Slovenia, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.
(3)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article was committed by employing workers who are not qualified to perform work with special authorisations or with the right to interfere with the physical or mental integrity of an individual or under particularly exploitative working conditions or by exploiting a victim of human trafficking or by employing a minor, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.

Violation of rights to participation in management and violation of trade union rights

## 200. člen

(1)	Whoever, by violating regulations or general acts, prevents or makes it impossible for workers to exercise their rights to participation in management or abuses these rights or obstructs their exercise, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever, by violating regulations or general acts, prevents or makes it impossible for workers to freely associate and engage in trade union activities or obstructs the exercise of trade union rights or takes over a trade union.

Endangering safety at work

## 201. člen

(1)	Whoever destroys, damages or removes safety devices in a mine, factory, construction site or any other workplace and thereby causes danger to human life, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	A person who is responsible for safety and health at work in mines, factories, workshops, construction sites or other workplaces and fails to install safety devices or fails to ensure their proper condition or fails to ensure their operation when necessary, or otherwise fails to act in accordance with regulations or technical rules on safety measures and thereby causes danger to human life, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.
(3)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to one year.
(4)	If the act from the first, second or third paragraph of this article results in serious bodily injury to one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first or second paragraph of this article by imprisonment of up to five years, and for the act from the third paragraph by imprisonment of up to three years.

(5)	If the act from the first, second or third paragraph of this article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first or second paragraph by imprisonment of one to twelve years, and for the act from the third paragraph by imprisonment of one to eight years.

Violation of rights arising from social insurance

## 202. člen

Whoever fails to act in accordance with regulations on social insurance and thereby deprives someone of a right to which they are entitled, or limits it, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.

Abuse of rights arising from social insurance

## 203. člen

(1)	Whoever feigns or causes themselves an illness or incapacity for work and thereby obtains recognition of a right under social insurance to which they would not be entitled, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.
(2)	Whoever submits false documents to the competent authority or makes a false statement and thereby deceives it into issuing a decision on a pension, disability benefit or monetary social supplement, even though the conditions for issuing such a decision are not met, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.

Twenty-third chapter
CRIMINAL OFFENCES AGAINST PROPERTY

Theft

## 204. člen

(1)	Whoever takes another person's movable property in order to unlawfully appropriate it, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	If the value of the stolen property is small and the perpetrator intended to appropriate property of such value, they shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.
(3)	Prosecution for the act from the previous paragraph shall be initiated upon proposal.
(4)	If the perpetrator returned the stolen property to the injured party before learning that criminal proceedings had been instituted, the punishment may be remitted.

Aggravated theft

## 205. člen

(1)	The perpetrator of theft from the first paragraph of the previous article shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years:
1)	if they committed the theft by gaining access to a locked building, room, safe, cupboard or other locked premises by breaking in, burglary or otherwise overcoming major obstacles;
2)	if the theft was committed by two or more persons who joined together for the purpose of stealing;
3)	if they committed the theft in a particularly audacious manner;
4)	if they had on their person any weapon or dangerous tool for attack or defence;
5)	if they committed the theft during a fire, flood or similar natural disaster;
6)	if they committed the theft by exploiting another person's helplessness or misfortune.
(2)	The perpetrator of theft shall be punished in the same manner if the stolen property is of special cultural significance or a natural asset or if the stolen property is of great value and the perpetrator intended to appropriate such property or property of such value.
(3)	If the act from the first paragraph of this article resulted in the acquisition of property of special cultural significance or property of great value and the perpetrator intended to appropriate such property or property of such value, or if the act from the second paragraph of this article was committed in a criminal organisation, they shall be punished by imprisonment of one to eight years.

Robbery

## 206. člen

(1)	Whoever takes another person's movable property in order to unlawfully appropriate it by using force against any person or threatening them with an immediate attack on life or body, shall be punished by imprisonment of one to ten years.
(2)	If the robbery was committed by two or more persons who joined together for the purpose of robbing, or if the value of the stolen property is great and the perpetrator intended to appropriate property of such value, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of three to fifteen years.
(3)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article was committed in a criminal organisation, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of five to fifteen years.

Robbery-theft

## 207. člen

(1)	Whoever is caught in the act of theft and, in order to retain the stolen property, uses force against someone or threatens them with an immediate attack on life or body, shall be punished by imprisonment of one to ten years.
(2)	If the value of the stolen property is great and the perpetrator intended to appropriate property of such value, they shall be punished by imprisonment of three to fifteen years.

Misappropriation

## 208. člen

(1)	Whoever unlawfully appropriates another person's movable property entrusted to them, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.
(2)	If the value of the misappropriated property is small and the perpetrator intended to appropriate property of such value, they shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to six months.
(3)	If the act from the first paragraph of this article is committed by a guardian, they shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(4)	If the misappropriated property is of special cultural significance or a natural asset or if the misappropriated property is of great value and the perpetrator intended to appropriate such property or property of such value, they shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(5)	Whoever unlawfully appropriates another person's movable property which they found or came upon by chance, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.
(6)	Prosecution for the act from the first, second and fifth paragraphs of this article shall be initiated upon proposal.

Embezzlement and unauthorised use of another person's property

heading_path: Opozorilo: Neuradno prečiščeno besedilo predpisa predstavlja zgolj informativni delovni pripomoček, glede katerega organ ne jamči odškodninsko ali kako drugače.
text:
## 209. člen

(1)	Kdor si protipravno prilasti denar, premično stvar ali drug del tujega premoženja, ki mu je zaupano v zvezi z zaposlitvijo ali pri opravljanju gospodarske, finančne ali poslovne dejavnosti ali pri opravljanju dolžnosti skrbnika ali mu je prepuščeno kot uradni osebi v službi, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Če stori dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka uradna oseba proti tujemu premoženju, ki ji je dosegljivo ob preiskavi stanovanja, prostorov ali oseb, ob izvršbi v sodnem ali upravnem postopku ali v zvezi z nalogami varovanja oseb ali premoženja, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(3)	Če gre pri dejanju iz prvega odstavka tega člena za premoženje majhne vrednosti, pa si je storilec hotel prilastiti tako vrednost, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(4)	Če gre pri dejanju iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za premoženje velike vrednosti in si je storilec hotel pridobiti tako premoženjsko korist, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(5)	Če storilec zaupane ali dosegljive stvari iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena neupravičeno uporabi, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do treh let.

Odvzem motornega vozila

## 210. člen

(1)	Kdor vzame tuje motorno vozilo z namenom, da ga protipravno uporabi za vožnjo, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Poskus je kazniv.

(3)	Če storilec kaznivega dejanja iz prvega odstavka tega člena motorno vozilo uniči, ga napravi nerabnega, ali ga zapusti na neznanem kraju, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Goljufija

## 211. člen

(1)	Kdor, zato da bi sebi ali komu drugemu pridobil protipravno premoženjsko korist, spravi koga z lažnivim prikazovanjem ali prikrivanjem dejanskih okoliščin v zmoto ali ga pusti v zmoti in ga s tem zapelje, da ta v škodo svojega ali tujega premoženja kaj stori ali opusti, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Kdor z namenom iz prejšnjega odstavka tega člena v zavarovalništvu ob sklenitvi pogodbe navede lažne podatke ali zamolči pomembne podatke, sklene prepovedano dvojno zavarovanje ali sklene zavarovalno pogodbo potem, ko je zavarovalni ali škodni primer že nastopil, ali lažno prikaže škodni dogodek, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(3)	Če sta goljufijo storili dve ali več oseb, ki so se združile zato, da bi goljufale, ali če je storilec z dejanjem iz prvega odstavka tega člena povzročil veliko premoženjsko škodo, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(4)	Če je bilo dejanje iz prvega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena storjeno v hudodelski združbi, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(5)	Če je z dejanjem iz prvega odstavka tega člena povzročena majhna premoženjska škoda in je storilec hotel pridobiti majhno premoženjsko korist, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(6)	Kdor, zato da bi drugega oškodoval, spravi koga z lažnim prikazovanjem ali prikrivanjem dejanskih okoliščin v zmoto ali ga pusti v zmoti in ga s tem zapelje, da ta v škodo svojega ali tujega premoženja kaj stori ali opusti, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(7)	Pregon za dejanje iz petega in šestega odstavka tega člena se začne na
predlog.

Organiziranje denarnih verig, nedovoljeno prirejanje iger na srečo in nedovoljeno prirejanje rezultatov športnih tekmovanj

## 212. člen

(1)	Kdor organizira, sodeluje ali pomaga pri organiziranju ali izvajanju denarnih verig, pri katerih udeleženci vplačujejo določene denarne zneske organizatorjem ali drugim udeležencem, ki so se pred njimi vključili v igro ali dejavnost in pričakujejo plačilo določenih denarnih zneskov od udeležencev, ki naj bi se za njimi vključili v tako igro ali dejavnost, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor, zato da bi sebi ali komu drugemu pridobil večjo protipravno premoženjsko korist, priredi, sodeluje ali pomaga pri prirejanju iger na srečo, za katere ni bilo izdano dovoljenje ali koncesija pristojnega organa.

(3)	Enako kot v prvem odstavku tega člena se kaznuje oseba, ki se zato, da bi sebi ali komu drugemu pridobila premoženjsko ali kakšno drugo korist, dogovori za nedovoljeno spremembo rezultata ali poteka uradnega športnega tekmovanja ali za tako spremembo kaj stori ali opusti.
(4)	Če si je z dejanji iz prvega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena sam ali kdo drug pridobil večjo premoženjsko korist ali povzročil drugemu večjo premoženjsko škodo, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(5)	Če si je z dejanji iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena sam ali kdo drug pridobil veliko premoženjsko korist ali povzročil drugemu veliko premoženjsko škodo, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.

Izsiljevanje

## 213. člen

(1)	Kdor, zato da bi sebi ali komu drugemu pridobil protipravno premoženjsko korist, s silo ali resno grožnjo koga prisili, da kaj stori ali opusti v škodo svojega ali tujega premoženja, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor, zato da bi sebi ali komu drugemu pridobil protipravno premoženjsko korist, komu zagrozi, da bo o njem ali njegovih bližnjih odkril kaj, kar bi škodovalo njihovi časti ali dobremu imenu, in ga s tem prisili, da v škodo svojega ali tujega premoženja kaj stori ali opusti.
(3)	Če dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena storita dve ali več oseb ali če je storjeno z uporabo orožja ali nevarnega orodja ali na posebej surov in poniževalen način, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(4)	Če je bilo dejanje iz prejšnjih odstavkov storjeno v hudodelski združbi, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.

Oderuštvo

## 214. člen

Kdor sprejme ali si za uslugo, ki jo nekomu stori, zase ali za koga drugega zagotovi očitno nesorazmerno premoženjsko korist, s tem da izrabi njegovo slabo premoženjsko stanje, hude stanovanjske razmere, stisko, nezadostno izkušenost ali lahkomiselnost, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let in z denarno kaznijo.

Izneverjenje

## 215. člen

(1)	Kdor zastopa premoženjske koristi kakšne osebe ali oskrbuje njeno premoženje, pa zavestno ne izpolni svoje obveznosti delati v njeno korist ali dela v njeno škodo, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

(2)	Če storilec ob storitvi dejanja iz prejšnjega odstavka izrabi pooblastilo za pridobitev premoženjske koristi sebi ali komu drugemu, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(3)	Če stori dejanje iz drugega odstavka tega člena odvetnik, notar, skrbnik, izvršitelj ali stečajni upravitelj ali če si storilec pridobi veliko premoženjsko korist, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.

Zloraba izvršbe

## 216. člen

(1)	Kdor v izvršbi protipravno izterja več, kot je kdo dolžan plačati, ali si prilasti zmotno preplačilo dolga, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor v izvršbi izigra upnika za njegovo terjatev z dogovorom z udeleženci dražbe.
(3)	Poskus je kazniv.

## 209. člen

(1)	Whoever unlawfully appropriates money, a movable thing or another part of another's property entrusted to him in connection with employment or in the performance of economic, financial or business activity or in the performance of the duties of a guardian, or left to him as an official person in service, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	If the act from the previous paragraph is committed by an official person against another's property accessible to him during a search of a dwelling, premises or persons, during enforcement in judicial or administrative proceedings, or in connection with tasks of protecting persons or property, he shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.
(3)	If the act from the first paragraph of this article concerns property of small value and the perpetrator intended to appropriate such value, he shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(4)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article concerns property of large value and the perpetrator intended to obtain such pecuniary benefit, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(5)	If the perpetrator unlawfully uses entrusted or accessible things from the first or second paragraph of this article, he shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to three years.

Odvzem motornega vozila

## 210. člen

(1)	Whoever takes another's motor vehicle with the intention of unlawfully using it for driving shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.
(2)	An attempt is punishable.

(3)	If the perpetrator of the criminal offence from the first paragraph of this article destroys the motor vehicle, renders it unusable, or abandons it in an unknown place, he shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.

Goljufija

## 211. člen

(1)	Whoever, in order to obtain an unlawful pecuniary benefit for himself or another, induces someone into error by false representation or concealment of factual circumstances or leaves him in error and thereby induces him to do or omit something to the detriment of his own or another's property, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	Whoever, with the intention from the previous paragraph of this article, in insurance upon conclusion of a contract provides false information or conceals important information, concludes prohibited double insurance or concludes an insurance contract after the insured event or loss event has already occurred, or falsely represents a loss event, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.
(3)	If fraud is committed by two or more persons who have joined together to commit fraud, or if the perpetrator by the act from the first paragraph of this article caused large pecuniary damage, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(4)	If the act from the first or third paragraph of this article was committed in a criminal organisation, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(5)	If the act from the first paragraph of this article caused small pecuniary damage and the perpetrator intended to obtain small pecuniary benefit, he shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(6)	Whoever, in order to harm another, induces someone into error by false representation or concealment of factual circumstances or leaves him in error and thereby induces him to do or omit something to the detriment of his own or another's property, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(7)	Prosecution for the act from the fifth and sixth paragraph of this article shall be initiated upon
proposal.

Organiziranje denarnih verig, nedovoljeno prirejanje iger na srečo in nedovoljeno prirejanje rezultatov športnih tekmovanj

## 212. člen

(1)	Whoever organises, participates or assists in organising or carrying out money chains in which participants pay certain amounts of money to organisers or other participants who joined the game or activity before them and expect payment of certain amounts of money from participants who are to join such game or activity after them, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever, in order to obtain a larger unlawful pecuniary benefit for himself or another, organises, participates or assists in organising games of chance for which no permit or concession has been issued by the competent authority.

(3)	The same punishment as in the first paragraph of this article shall apply to a person who, in order to obtain a pecuniary or any other benefit for himself or another, agrees to an unauthorised change of the result or course of an official sports competition or does or omits something for such a change.
(4)	If by the acts from the first or third paragraph of this article he himself or another obtained a larger pecuniary benefit or caused another larger pecuniary damage, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.
(5)	If by the acts from the first, second or third paragraph of this article he himself or another obtained a large pecuniary benefit or caused another large pecuniary damage, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.

Izsiljevanje

## 213. člen

(1)	Whoever, in order to obtain an unlawful pecuniary benefit for himself or another, by force or serious threat compels someone to do or omit something to the detriment of his own or another's property, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever, in order to obtain an unlawful pecuniary benefit for himself or another, threatens someone that he will reveal something about him or his relatives that would harm their honour or good name, and thereby compels him to do or omit something to the detriment of his own or another's property.
(3)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article is committed by two or more persons or if it is committed using a weapon or dangerous tool or in a particularly brutal and humiliating manner, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(4)	If the act from the previous paragraphs was committed in a criminal organisation, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.

Oderuštvo

## 214. člen

Whoever accepts or secures for himself or another a manifestly disproportionate pecuniary benefit for a service he renders to someone, by exploiting his poor financial situation, severe housing conditions, distress, insufficient experience or recklessness, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years and by a fine.

Izneverjenje

## 215. člen

(1)	Whoever represents the pecuniary interests of a person or manages his property and knowingly fails to fulfil his obligation to act in his interest or acts to his detriment, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.

(2)	If the perpetrator in committing the act from the previous paragraph exploits the authorisation to obtain pecuniary benefit for himself or another, he shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(3)	If the act from the second paragraph of this article is committed by a lawyer, notary, guardian, enforcement agent or bankruptcy administrator, or if the perpetrator obtains a large pecuniary benefit, he shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.

Zloraba izvršbe

(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever in enforcement defrauds a creditor of his claim by agreement with auction participants.
(3)	An attempt is punishable.

## 217. člen

(1)	Kdor premično ali nepremično stvar, za katero ve, da je bila pridobljena s kaznivim dejanjem, kupi, sprejme v zastavo, si kako drugače pridobi, prikrije ali razpeča, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Kdor stori dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka, pa bi moral in mogel vedeti, da je bila stvar pridobljena s kaznivim dejanjem, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(3)	Če sta dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena storili dve ali več oseb, ki so se združile zaradi prikrivanja ali je vrednost stvari iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena večja ali je stvar posebnega kulturnega pomena ali naravna vrednota, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega odstavka z zaporom do treh let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka pa z zaporom do dveh let.
(4)	Če je bila prikrita stvar pridobljena s kaznivim dejanjem, za katero se storilec preganja na zasebno tožbo ali predlog, se storilec dejanj iz prvega in drugega odstavka tega člena preganja na zasebno tožbo oziroma na predlog.
(5)	Če je bilo dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena storjeno v hudodelski združbi za izvedbo kaznivih dejanj, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.

Nedovoljena posest in promet s stvarmi, ki so posebnega kulturnega pomena ali naravne vrednote

## 218. člen

(1)	Kdor brez dovoljenja pristojnega organa odnese v tujino ali kdor iz nje v nasprotju z mednarodnim pravom prinese stvar, ki je posebnega kulturnega pomena ali naravna vrednota, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor daje na trg ali drugače ponuja naprodaj stvari iz prejšnjega odstavka, za katere ve, da so bile pridobljene protipravno, ali kdor protipravno poseduje stvar, ki je posebnega kulturnega pomena ali naravna vrednota.
(3)	Če je stvar iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena velikega ali izjemnega kulturnega pomena, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.

Poškodovanje, odstranitev ali uničenje stvari, ki so posebnega kulturnega pomena ali naravne vrednote

## 219. člen

(1)	Kdor protipravno poškoduje, odstrani ali uniči stvar, ki je posebnega kulturnega pomena, naravno vrednoto ali drugo zavarovano naravno bogastvo ali stvar, ki je javna dobrina, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Če je poškodovana ali uničena stvar kulturni spomenik ali naravna vrednota velikega ali izjemnega pomena za Republiko Slovenijo ali če je povzročena škoda velika, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do osmih let.

Poškodovanje tuje stvari

## 220. člen

(1)	Kdor tujo stvar poškoduje, uniči ali napravi neuporabno, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Če je povzročena škoda velika, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(3)	Pregon za dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena se začne na predlog.

Napad na informacijski sistem

## 221. člen

(1)	Kdor neupravičeno vstopi ali vdre v informacijski sistem ali kdor neupravičeno prestreže podatek ob nejavnem prenosu v informacijski sistem ali iz njega, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Kdor podatke v informacijskem sistemu neupravičeno uporabi, spremeni, preslika, prenaša, uniči ali v informacijski sistem neupravičeno vnese kakšen podatek, ovira prenos ali dostop do podatkov ali ovira delovanje informacijskega sistema, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

(3)	Če je bilo z dejanjem iz prejšnjega odstavka z uporabo pripomočkov iz tretjega odstavka 306. člena tega zakonika ovirano delovanje ali so bili drugače prizadeti trije ali več informacijskih sistemov, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od treh mesecev do štirih let.
(4)	Če je z dejanjem iz drugega odstavka tega člena povzročena velika škoda ali je bilo dejanje storjeno v hudodelski združbi ali nad informacijskim sistemom upravljavca kritične infrastrukture ali nad informacijskim sistemom zavezanca po zakonu, ki ureja informacijsko varnost, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od treh mesecev do petih let.

Požig

## 222. člen

(1)	Kdor požge tujo hišo ali drugo stavbo, namenjeno za prebivanje, gospodarsko poslopje ali poslovno stavbo, stavbo ali drugo nepremičnino, ki je v javni rabi, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(2)	Če so požgane stvari iz prejšnjega odstavka last tistega, ki je požgal, ravnal pa je iz zlobnih ali drugih nizkotnih nagibov, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(3)	Če je dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(4)	Če sta dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena storili dve ali več oseb ali če je požgana stvar posebnega kulturnega pomena, naravna vrednota ali velike vrednosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.

Oškodovanje tujih pravic

## 223. člen

(1)	Kdor, zato da bi komu preprečil uveljavitev stvarne pravice, odtuji, uniči, poškoduje ali vzame svojo stvar, na kateri ima ta zastavno pravico ali pravico užitka, in ga s tem oškoduje, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje tudi, kdor, zato da bi preprečil plačilo upnika, med prisilno izvršbo uniči, poškoduje, odtuji ali skrije dele svojega premoženja in s tem upnika oškoduje.
(3)	Pregon za dejanje iz prvega in drugega odstavka tega člena se začne na
predlog.

Pregon, kadar je storilec v bližnjem razmerju z oškodovancem

## 224. člen

Za kaznivo dejanje iz 204., 205., prvega, drugega, četrtega in petega odstavka 208., 210., 211., prvega in drugega odstavka 215. in 220. člena tega zakonika, ki so bila storjena proti zakoncu ali osebi, s katero živi v zunajzakonski skupnosti, ali partnerju iz registrirane istospolne partnerske skupnosti, krvnemu sorodniku v ravni vrsti, bratu ali sestri ali drugemu krvnemu sorodniku v stranski vrsti do vštetega tretjega kolena, sorodniku po

svaštvu do vštetega drugega kolena, posvojitelju ali posvojencu, rejniku ali rejencu ali proti drugim osebam, s katerimi živi storilec v skupnem gospodinjstvu, se pregon začne na zasebno tožbo.

Štiriindvajseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER GOSPODARSTVO

Protipravno omejevanje konkurence

## 225. člen

(1)	Kdor pri opravljanju gospodarske dejavnosti v nasprotju s predpisi, ki urejajo varstvo konkurence, krši prepoved omejevalnih sporazumov med podjetji, zlorabi prevladujoči položaj enega ali več podjetij ali ustvari prepovedano koncentracijo podjetij in s tem prepreči ali pomembno ovira ali izkrivlja konkurenco v Republiki Sloveniji ali na trgu Evropske unije ali njenem pomembnem delu, ali pomembno vpliva na trgovino med državami članicami, kar ima za posledico veliko premoženjsko korist za to podjetje ali za ta podjetja ali veliko premoženjsko škodo za drugo podjetje, se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do petih let.
(2)	Storilcu kaznivega dejanja kršitve prepovedi omejevalnih sporazumov iz prejšnjega odstavka, ki je dejanje naznanil, preden je bilo odkrito ali preden je izvedel, da je odkrito in je sodeloval pri njegovem preiskovanju in odpravljanju posledic ter ni prisilil drugih k udeležbi pri omejevanju konkurence, niti jih ni prisilil, da so v njej še naprej udeleženi, se sme kazen odpustiti.

Oškodovanje upnikov z goljufijo ali nevestnim poslovanjem
translated_text:
## Article 217

(1) Whoever purchases, accepts as a pledge, otherwise acquires, conceals or disposes of movable or immovable property, knowing that it was obtained through a criminal offence, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.
(2) Whoever commits the act from the preceding paragraph, but should and could have known that the property was obtained through a criminal offence, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(3) If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article was committed by two or more persons who joined together for the purpose of concealment, or if the value of the property from the first or second paragraph of this article is greater, or if the property is of special cultural significance or a natural asset, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first paragraph by imprisonment for up to three years, and for the act from the second paragraph by imprisonment for up to two years.
(4) If the concealed property was obtained through a criminal offence for which the perpetrator is prosecuted upon private action or motion, the perpetrator of the acts from the first and second paragraphs of this article shall be prosecuted upon private action or motion respectively.
(5) If the act from the first, second or third paragraph of this article was committed in a criminal organisation for the commission of criminal offences, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.

Unlawful possession of and trade in property of special cultural significance or natural assets

## Article 218

(1) Whoever takes abroad without authorisation from the competent authority, or whoever brings from abroad in contravention of international law, property of special cultural significance or a natural asset, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2) The same punishment shall apply to whoever places on the market or otherwise offers for sale property from the preceding paragraph, knowing that it was obtained unlawfully, or whoever unlawfully possesses property of special cultural significance or a natural asset.
(3) If the property from the first or second paragraph of this article is of great or exceptional cultural significance, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.

Damage, removal or destruction of property of special cultural significance or natural assets

## Article 219

(1) Whoever unlawfully damages, removes or destroys property of special cultural significance, a natural asset or other protected natural resource, or property that is a public good, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.
(2) If the damaged or destroyed property is a cultural monument or natural asset of great or exceptional significance for the Republic of Slovenia, or if the damage caused is substantial, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to eight years.

Damage to another's property

## Article 220

(1) Whoever damages, destroys or renders unusable another's property shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to two years.
(2) If the damage caused is substantial, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.
(3) Prosecution for the act from the first paragraph of this article shall be instituted upon motion.

Attack on an information system

## Article 221

(1) Whoever unlawfully enters or breaks into an information system, or whoever unlawfully intercepts data during non-public transmission to or from an information system, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.
(2) Whoever unlawfully uses, modifies, copies, transmits, destroys data in an information system, or unlawfully enters any data into an information system, obstructs transmission or access to data, or obstructs the operation of an information system, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.

(3) If by the act from the preceding paragraph, using the devices from the third paragraph of Article 306 of this Code, the operation of three or more information systems was obstructed or they were otherwise affected, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to four years.
(4) If by the act from the second paragraph of this article substantial damage was caused, or if the act was committed in a criminal organisation or against an information system of a critical infrastructure operator or against an information system of an obliged entity under the law governing information security, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.

Arson

## Article 222

(1) Whoever sets fire to another's house or other building intended for habitation, farm building or business building, building or other immovable property in public use, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(2) If the property from the preceding paragraph is owned by the person who set the fire, but acted out of malicious or other base motives, he shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.
(3) If the act from the first paragraph of this article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(4) If the act from the first paragraph of this article was committed by two or more persons, or if the property set on fire is of special cultural significance, a natural asset or of great value, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.

Prejudicing another's rights

## Article 223

(1) Whoever, in order to prevent someone from asserting a property right, alienates, destroys, damages or takes his own property on which that person has a pledge right or usufruct right, and thereby causes him damage, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(2) The same punishment shall apply to whoever, in order to prevent payment to a creditor, during enforcement proceedings destroys, damages, alienates or conceals parts of his property and thereby causes damage to the creditor.
(3) Prosecution for the act from the first and second paragraphs of this article shall be instituted upon motion.

Prosecution where the perpetrator is in a close relationship with the injured party

## Article 224

For the criminal offence from Articles 204, 205, first, second, fourth and fifth paragraphs of 208, 210, 211, first and second paragraphs of 215 and 220 of this Code, committed against a spouse or person with whom he lives in an extramarital union, or a partner from a registered same-sex partnership, a blood relative in direct line, brother or sister or other blood relative in collateral line up to and including the third degree, relative by affinity up to and including the second degree, adoptive parent or adopted child, foster parent or foster child, or against other persons with whom the perpetrator lives in a common household, prosecution shall be instituted upon private action.

Chapter Twenty-Four
CRIMINAL OFFENCES AGAINST THE ECONOMY

Unlawful restriction of competition

## Article 225

(1) Whoever, in the course of carrying out economic activity, in contravention of regulations governing the protection of competition, violates the prohibition of restrictive agreements between undertakings, abuses the dominant position of one or more undertakings, or creates a prohibited concentration of undertakings, and thereby prevents or significantly impedes or distorts competition in the Republic of Slovenia or in the market of the European Union or a substantial part thereof, or significantly affects trade between Member States, which results in substantial pecuniary gain for that undertaking or those undertakings or substantial pecuniary damage to another undertaking, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(2) A perpetrator of the criminal offence of violation of the prohibition of restrictive agreements from the preceding paragraph, who reported the act before it was discovered or before he learned that it was discovered and cooperated in its investigation and elimination of consequences, and did not coerce others to participate in the restriction of competition, nor coerce them to continue participating in it, may have the punishment remitted.
