## 226. člen

(1)	Kdor ve, da je sam ali kdo drug kot dolžnik insolventen, pa onemogoči ali zmanjša možnost poravnave obveznosti do upnikov, tako da:
1.	premoženje ali njegov del prikrije, poškoduje, odstrani, navidezno, brezplačno ali za nerazumno nizko ceno odsvoji ali uniči;
2.	sklene lažno pogodbo o dolgu ali prizna neresnično terjatev;
3.	prikrije, uniči, spremeni ali tako vodi poslovne knjige, listine ali poročila, da iz njih ni mogoče pravočasno ali pravilno ugotoviti dejanskega premoženjskega stanja, plačilne sposobnosti ali kapitalske ustreznosti dolžnika, oziroma poslovnih knjig, listin ali poročil sploh ne vodi;
4.	na drug goljufiv način navidezno ali dejansko poslabša svoje premoženjsko stanje ali premoženjsko stanje drugega dolžnika,
se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do petih let.
(2)	Kdor ve, da je sam ali kdo drug kot dolžnik insolventen, pa navidezno ali dejansko poslabša svoje premoženjsko stanje ali premoženjsko stanje drugega dolžnika, tako da:
1.	nesmotrno troši sredstva, se nesorazmerno zadolžuje, opušča pravočasno zavarovanje in uveljavljanje terjatev ali sklepa špekulativne ali škodljive posle;
2.	brez potrebe prenaša na druge osebe, obremenjuje ali drugače zmanjšuje vrednost svojega premoženja ali premoženja oziroma podjetja, ki ga upravlja;

3.	ne izvršuje zakonskih obveznosti pri nastanku insolventnosti ali krši temeljna pravila v postopkih insolventnosti;
4.	kako drugače očitno krši svoje dolžnosti pri vodenju gospodarske dejavnosti ali finančnem poslovanju,
se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(3)	Če je zaradi dejanj iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena nastala velika premoženjska škoda, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.

Dajanje prednosti upnikom

## 227. člen

(1)	Kdor ve, da je sam ali kdo drug kot dolžnik insolventen, pa izplača dolg ali kako drugače namenoma spravi kakšnega upnika v ugodnejši položaj in tako povzroči premoženjsko škodo drugim upnikom, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Če je bila z dejanjem iz prejšnjega odstavka povzročena velika premoženjska škoda, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.

Poslovna goljufija

## 228. člen

(1)	Kdor pri opravljanju gospodarske dejavnosti pri sklenitvi ali izvajanju pogodbe ali posla preslepi drugega s prikazovanjem, da bodo obveznosti izpolnjene, ali s prikrivanjem, da obveznosti ne bodo ali ne bodo mogle biti izpolnjene, zaradi delne ali celotne neizpolnitve obveznosti pa si pridobi premoženjsko korist ali nastane za stranko ali koga drugega premoženjska škoda, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Če je zaradi dejanja iz prejšnjega odstavka pridobljena velika premoženjska korist ali nastala velika premoženjska škoda, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(3)	Če je zaradi dejanja iz prvega odstavka tega člena pridobljena majhna premoženjska korist ali nastala majhna premoženjska škoda, se storilec kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

Goljufija na škodo Evropske unije

## 229. člen

(1)	Kdor se izogne odhodkom s tem, da uporabi ali predloži lažne, nepravilne ali nepopolne izjave ali dokumente ali ne razkrije podatkov in tako povzroči škodo splošnemu proračunu Evropske unije, proračunu, ki ga upravlja Evropska unija, ali proračunu, ki se upravlja v imenu Evropske unije, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh mesecev do petih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor poneveri, neupravičeno zadržuje ali neustrezno uporabi sredstva splošnega proračuna Evropske unije, proračuna, ki ga upravlja Evropska unija, ali proračuna, ki se upravlja v imenu Evropske unije.

(3)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor pridobi sredstva iz proračunov iz prvega in drugega odstavka tega člena s tem, da uporabi ali predloži lažne, nepravilne ali nepopolne izjave ali dokumente ali ne razkrije podatkov.
(4)	Če je bila z dejanjem iz prejšnjih odstavkov pridobljena velika premoženjska korist ali povzročena velika premoženjska škoda, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(5)	S kaznimi iz prejšnjih odstavkov tega člena se kaznujejo vodje podjetij ali druge osebe, ki so pooblaščene za sprejemanje odločitev ali nadzor v podjetjih, če omogočijo ali ne preprečijo kaznivih dejanj storilcem iz prejšnjih odstavkov, ki so jim podrejeni in delujejo v imenu podjetja.

Preslepitev pri pridobitvi in uporabi posojila ali ugodnosti

## 230. člen

(1)	Kdor zase ali za koga drugega pridobi posojilo, investicijska sredstva, subvencijo ali kakšno drugo ugodnost za opravljanje gospodarske dejavnosti, čeprav ne izpolnjuje zahtevanih pogojev, s tem da posojilodajalcu ali drugemu, ki je pristojen za podelitev ali odobritev take ugodnosti, predloži neresnične ali nepopolne podatke o premoženjskem stanju, bilancah, dobičku ali izgubi ali druge podatke, pomembne za odobritev posojila ali ugodnosti oziroma te podatke zamolči, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Kdor tistega, ki je podelil ali odobril posojilo ali ugodnost iz prejšnjega odstavka, preslepi glede namena uporabe ali mu prikrije, da jih je uporabil v druge namene, kot so bili odobreni ali dogovorjeni, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.

Preslepitev pri poslovanju z vrednostnimi papirji

## 231. člen

(1)	Kdor zaradi trgovanja z delnicami, drugimi vrednostnimi papirji ali drugimi finančnimi instrumenti lažno prikaže premoženjsko stanje, podatke o dobičku ali izgubi ali druge podatke v prospektu, pri objavi letnega poročila ali na drug način, ki pomembno vplivajo na njihovo vrednost, in s tem zapelje eno ali več oseb, da jih kupijo, prodajo ali z njimi na drug način poslujejo, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Če je šlo pri dejanju iz prejšnjega odstavka za vrednostne papirje ali druge finančne instrumente velike vrednosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.

Preslepitev kupcev

## 232. člen

(1)	Kdor, zato da bi preslepil kupce, v večjem obsegu razpečava izdelke z oznako, v kateri so podatki, ki ne ustrezajo vsebini, vrsti, izvoru ali kakovosti blaga, ali razpečava izdelke, ki niso toliko težki ali take kakovosti, kot se pri njih navadno domneva, ali razpečava

izdelke brez oznake o vsebini, vrsti, izvoru, kakovosti ali trajanju izdelka, če je taka oznaka predpisana, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor sklepa pogodbe z lažnimi navedbami o dobavnem roku ali načinu izpolnitve obveznosti kot bistvenem sestavnem delu pogodbe.
(3)	Kdor, zato da bi preslepil kupce ali uporabnike storitev, lažno objavi, da je znižana cena blaga ali da se blago razprodaja ali da se bodo cene zvišale ali uporablja kakšen drug lažen oglas, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo.

Neupravičena uporaba tuje oznake ali modela

## 233. člen

(1)	Kdor pri gospodarskem poslovanju neupravičeno uporabi tujo firmo, znamko, geografsko označbo ali drugo posebno oznako za blago ali storitev ali uporabi bistveni del te oznake kot svojo firmo, znamko ali drug znak za označevanje blaga ali storitev, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor pri gospodarskem poslovanju neupravičeno uporabi
tuji model.
(3)	Predmeti iz prvega in drugega odstavka tega člena ter orodja in naprave, ki se uporabljajo za njihovo izdelovanje, se vzamejo.

Neupravičena uporaba tujega izuma ali topografije

## 234. člen

(1)	Kdor pri gospodarskem poslovanju neupravičeno uporabi tuji izum, zavarovan s patentom ali dodatnim varstvenim certifikatom, ali registrirano topografijo polprevodniškega vezja, ali novo rastlinsko sorto, zavarovano z žlahtniteljsko pravico, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Proizvodi, izdelani na podlagi neupravičene uporabe iz prejšnjega odstavka, se
vzamejo.

Ponareditev ali uničenje poslovnih listin
translated_text:
## 226. člen

(1) Whoever knows that they themselves or another person as a debtor is insolvent, and prevents or reduces the possibility of settling obligations to creditors by:
1. concealing, damaging, removing, fictitiously, gratuitously or for an unreasonably low price alienating or destroying assets or a part thereof;
2. concluding a false debt contract or acknowledging a false claim;
3. concealing, destroying, altering or keeping business books, documents or reports in such a way that the actual financial situation, solvency or capital adequacy of the debtor cannot be determined in a timely or correct manner, or not keeping business books, documents or reports at all;
4. in another fraudulent manner fictitiously or actually worsening their own financial situation or the financial situation of another debtor,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(2) Whoever knows that they themselves or another person as a debtor is insolvent, and fictitiously or actually worsens their own financial situation or the financial situation of another debtor by:
1. wastefully spending funds, disproportionately incurring debt, failing to timely secure and enforce claims or concluding speculative or harmful transactions;
2. unnecessarily transferring to other persons, encumbering or otherwise reducing the value of their own assets or assets or enterprise that they manage;

3. not fulfilling legal obligations upon the occurrence of insolvency or violating fundamental rules in insolvency proceedings;
4. in some other way manifestly violating their duties in conducting economic activity or financial operations,
shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(3) If the acts referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Article have resulted in major property damage, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.

Giving preference to creditors

## 227. člen

(1) Whoever knows that they themselves or another person as a debtor is insolvent, and pays a debt or otherwise intentionally places a creditor in a more favourable position and thereby causes property damage to other creditors, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(2) If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph has caused major property damage, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.

Commercial fraud

## 228. člen

(1) Whoever, in the course of conducting economic activity, in the conclusion or performance of a contract or transaction, deceives another by representing that obligations will be fulfilled, or by concealing that obligations will not or cannot be fulfilled, and due to partial or complete non-fulfilment of obligations obtains a property benefit or causes property damage to the other party or another person, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(2) If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph has resulted in obtaining a major property benefit or causing major property damage, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(3) If the act referred to in the first paragraph of this Article has resulted in obtaining a minor property benefit or causing minor property damage, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.

Fraud to the detriment of the European Union

## 229. člen

(1) Whoever avoids expenditure by using or submitting false, incorrect or incomplete statements or documents or by not disclosing information and thereby causes damage to the general budget of the European Union, a budget managed by the European Union, or a budget managed on behalf of the European Union, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.
(2) The same punishment shall apply to whoever misappropriates, unlawfully withholds or inappropriately uses funds from the general budget of the European Union, a budget managed by the European Union, or a budget managed on behalf of the European Union.

(3) The same punishment shall apply to whoever obtains funds from the budgets referred to in the first and second paragraphs of this Article by using or submitting false, incorrect or incomplete statements or documents or by not disclosing information.
(4) If the act referred to in the preceding paragraphs has resulted in obtaining a major property benefit or causing major property damage, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(5) The punishments referred to in the preceding paragraphs of this Article shall apply to managers of enterprises or other persons authorised to make decisions or exercise supervision in enterprises, if they enable or fail to prevent the criminal offences by perpetrators referred to in the preceding paragraphs who are subordinate to them and act on behalf of the enterprise.

Deception in obtaining and using loans or benefits

## 230. člen

(1) Whoever obtains for themselves or for another person a loan, investment funds, a subsidy or any other benefit for conducting economic activity, even though they do not meet the required conditions, by submitting to the lender or another person competent to grant or approve such a benefit false or incomplete information about the financial situation, balance sheets, profit or loss or other information relevant to the approval of the loan or benefit, or by concealing such information, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to three years.
(2) Whoever deceives the person who granted or approved the loan or benefit referred to in the preceding paragraph regarding the purpose of use or conceals from them that they have used it for purposes other than those approved or agreed upon, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to two years.

Deception in trading securities

## 231. člen

(1) Whoever, for the purpose of trading in shares, other securities or other financial instruments, falsely represents the financial situation, information about profit or loss or other information in a prospectus, in the publication of an annual report or in another manner that significantly affects their value, and thereby induces one or more persons to buy, sell or otherwise transact with them, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to two years.
(2) If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph involved securities or other financial instruments of great value, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.

Deception of buyers

## 232. člen

(1) Whoever, in order to deceive buyers, distributes on a large scale products with a label containing information that does not correspond to the content, type, origin or quality of the goods, or distributes products that are not as heavy or of such quality as is normally assumed, or distributes

products without a label indicating the content, type, origin, quality or durability of the product, if such a label is prescribed, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to two years.
(2) The same punishment shall apply to whoever concludes contracts with false statements about the delivery deadline or manner of fulfilment of obligations as an essential component of the contract.
(3) Whoever, in order to deceive buyers or users of services, falsely announces that the price of goods has been reduced or that goods are being sold off or that prices will be increased or uses any other false advertisement, shall be punished by a fine.

Unauthorised use of another's designation or design

## 233. člen

(1) Whoever in business operations unlawfully uses another's company name, trademark, geographical indication or other special designation for goods or services or uses a substantial part of such designation as their own company name, trademark or other sign for designating goods or services, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2) The same punishment shall apply to whoever in business operations unlawfully uses
another's design.
(3) The objects referred to in the first and second paragraphs of this Article and the tools and devices used for their manufacture shall be confiscated.

Unauthorised use of another's invention or topography

## 234. člen

(1) Whoever in business operations unlawfully uses another's invention protected by a patent or supplementary protection certificate, or a registered topography of a semiconductor product, or a new plant variety protected by a plant breeder's right, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2) Products manufactured on the basis of the unauthorised use referred to in the preceding paragraph shall be
confiscated.

Forgery or destruction of business documents

## 235. člen

(1)	Kdor v poslovne knjige, spise ali druge poslovne listine in evidence, ki jih mora voditi po zakonu ali na podlagi drugih predpisov, izdanih na podlagi zakona, in so pomembne za poslovni promet z drugimi pravnimi ali fizičnimi osebami ali so namenjene za odločitve v zvezi z gospodarsko ali finančno dejavnostjo ali kot podlaga za davčni nadzor, vpiše lažne podatke ali ne vpiše kakšnega pomembnega podatka ali s svojim podpisom potrdi tako knjigo, listino ali spis z lažno vsebino ali omogoči sestavo knjige, listine ali spisa z lažno vsebino, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.

(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor lažno poslovno knjigo, listino ali spis uporabi kot resnično ali kdor uniči, skrije, precej poškoduje ali kako drugače napravi neuporabne poslovne knjige, listine ali spise iz prejšnjega odstavka.
(3)	Poskus dejanj iz prvega in drugega odstavka tega člena je kazniv.

Izdaja in neupravičena pridobitev poslovne skrivnosti

## 236. člen

(1)	Kdor neupravičeno v nasprotju s svojimi dolžnostmi glede varovanja poslovne skrivnosti sporoči ali izroči komu podatke, ki so poslovna skrivnost, ali mu kako drugače omogoči, da pride do njih, ali jih zbira z namenom, da jih izroči nepoklicani osebi, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor z namenom, da jih neupravičeno uporabi, protipravno pride do podatkov, ki se varujejo kot poslovna skrivnost.
(3)	Če so podatki iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena posebno pomembni, če kdo izroči take podatke zato, da jih kdo odnese v tujino, ali je dejanje storjeno iz koristoljubnosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(4)	Če je dejanje iz prvega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(5)	Za poslovno skrivnost se štejejo listine in podatki, ki so z zakonom, statutom, pravili ali drugim splošnim aktom ali odredbo pristojnega organa ali druge upravičene osebe razglašeni za industrijsko, bančno ali drugo poslovno skrivnost in so tako pomembni, da so z njihovo izdajo očitno nastale ali bi lahko nastale hujše škodljive posledice.

Zloraba informacijskega sistema

## 237. člen

(1)	Kdor pri gospodarskem poslovanju neupravičeno vstopi ali vdre v informacijski sistem ali ga neupravičeno uporablja tako, da uporabi, spremeni, preslika, prenaša, uniči ali v informacijski sistem vnese kakšen podatek, ovira prenos ali dostop do podatkov ali ovira delovanje informacijskega sistema ali neupravičeno prestreže podatek ob nejavnem prenosu v informacijski sistem, da bi sebi ali komu drugemu pridobil protipravno premoženjsko korist ali drugemu povzročil premoženjsko škodo, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Če je bila z dejanjem iz prejšnjega odstavka pridobljena velika premoženjska korist ali povzročena velika premoženjska škoda in je storilec hotel sebi ali komu drugemu pridobiti tako premoženjsko korist ali drugemu povzročiti tako premoženjsko škodo, ali če je bilo storjeno v hudodelski združbi ali nad informacijskim sistemom upravljavca kritične infrastrukture ali nad informacijskim sistemom zavezanca po zakonu, ki ureja informacijsko varnost, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh mesecev do petih let.

Zloraba notranje informacije

## 238. člen

(1)	Kdor notranjo informacijo, ki bi lahko pomembno vplivala na ceno vrednostnega papirja ali drugega finančnega instrumenta, uvrščenega na organiziran trg ali drugo mesto trgovanja v Republiki Sloveniji ali v vsaj eni državi članici Evropske unije ali za katero je bil vložen predlog za uvrstitev na tak trg, ne glede na to, ali je bil posel sklenjen na tem trgu ali zunaj njega, pridobi v zvezi s svojim položajem pri izdajatelju vrednostnega papirja ali lastniškim deležem v kapitalu izdajatelja vrednostnega papirja, svojo zaposlitvijo ali pri opravljanju dejavnosti in jo izkoristi zase ali za koga drugega za posredno ali neposredno pridobitev ali odsvojitev tega vrednostnega papirja ali drugega finančnega instrumenta ali za preklic ali spremembo naročila za trgovanje, če je bilo naročilo oddano, preden je oseba imela notranje informacije, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje oseba, ki notranjo informacijo sporoči nepoklicani osebi ali na podlagi notranje informacije priporoči tretji osebi posredno ali neposredno pridobitev ali odsvojitev tega vrednostnega papirja ali drugega finančnega instrumenta.
(3)	Enako kot v prvem odstavku se kaznuje oseba, ki nepooblaščeno pride do notranje informacije in jo izkoristi za posredno ali neposredno pridobitev ali odsvojitev tega vrednostnega papirja ali drugega finančnega instrumenta zase ali za koga drugega.
(4)	Enako kot v prvem odstavku tega člena se kaznuje oseba, ki stori dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena z vrednostnimi papirji ali drugimi finančnimi instrumenti na prostem trgu, če je njihova cena ali vrednost odvisna od cene ali vrednosti finančnih instrumentov na trgih iz prvega odstavka tega člena ali vpliva nanjo.
(5)	Če je pri dejanjih iz prejšnjih odstavkov šlo za vrednostne papirje ali druge finančne instrumente velike vrednosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.

Zloraba trga finančnih instrumentov

## 239. člen

(1) Kdor, zato da bi sebi ali komu drugemu pridobil protipravno premoženjsko korist, s prepovedanim ravnanjem zlorabi trg finančnih instrumentov, tako, da:
1)	sklene posel, izda naročilo za trgovanje ali drugače ravna tako, da udeležencem trga da napačno ali zavajajočo predstavo glede ponudbe, povpraševanja ali cene finančnega instrumenta ali povezane blagovne promptne pogodbe, ali s tem ena ali več povezanih oseb zagotovi ceno enega ali več finančnih instrumentov ali povezanih blagovnih promptnih pogodb na nenormalni ali umetni ravni;
2)	pri sklenitvi posla ali izdaji naročila za trgovanje uporabi fiktivna sredstva ali druge oblike goljufivega ravnanja;
3)	razširja napačne ali zavajajoče informacije o finančnih instrumentih ali povezanih blagovnih promptnih pogodbah, z istim ciljem razširja govorice ter napačne in zavajajoče novice po medijih, medmrežju ali na drug podoben način;
4)	posreduje lažne ali zavajajoče informacije ali zagotavlja lažne ali zavajajoče vhodne podatke ali drugače ravna tako, da se manipulira izračun referenčne vrednosti,
se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2) Če je bila z dejanjem iz prejšnjega odstavka pridobljena velika premoženjska korist ali povzročena velika premoženjska škoda in je storilec hotel sebi ali komu drugemu pridobiti tako premoženjsko korist ali drugemu povzročiti tako premoženjsko škodo, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.

Zloraba položaja ali zaupanja pri gospodarski dejavnosti

## 240. člen

(1)	Kdor pri opravljanju gospodarske dejavnosti zlorabi svoj položaj ali dano zaupanje, prekorači pravice ali opusti dolžnosti, ki jih ima na podlagi zakona, drugega predpisa, akta pravne osebe ali pravnega posla glede razpolaganja s tujim premoženjem ali koristmi, njihovega upravljanja ali zastopanja in s tem sebi ali komu drugemu pridobi protipravno premoženjsko korist ali povzroči premoženjsko škodo, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Če je bila z dejanjem iz prejšnjega odstavka pridobljena velika premoženjska korist ali povzročena velika premoženjska škoda in je storilec hotel sebi ali komu drugemu pridobiti tako premoženjsko korist ali drugemu povzročiti tako premoženjsko škodo, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(3)	Če je storilec z dejanjem iz prvega odstavka tega člena sebi ali komu drugemu pridobil nepremoženjsko korist, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.

translated_text:
## 235. člen

(1)	Whoever enters false data into business books, files or other business documents and records that must be kept pursuant to law or on the basis of other regulations issued pursuant to law, and which are important for business transactions with other legal or natural persons or are intended for decisions in connection with economic or financial activity or as a basis for tax supervision, or fails to enter any important data or with his signature confirms such a book, document or file with false content or enables the compilation of a book, document or file with false content, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.

(2)	Whoever uses a false business book, document or file as genuine or whoever destroys, conceals, considerably damages or otherwise renders unusable business books, documents or files from the preceding paragraph shall be punished in the same manner.
(3)	An attempt to commit the acts from the first and second paragraphs of this Article is punishable.

Disclosure and unauthorised acquisition of business secrets

## 236. člen

(1)	Whoever unlawfully, in breach of his duties regarding the protection of business secrets, communicates or hands over to someone data that constitute a business secret, or otherwise enables him to obtain them, or collects them with the intention of handing them over to an unauthorised person, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	Whoever unlawfully obtains data that are protected as a business secret with the intention of using them unlawfully shall be punished in the same manner.
(3)	If the data from the first or second paragraph of this Article are particularly important, if someone hands over such data so that someone takes them abroad, or if the act was committed out of greed, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(4)	If the act from the first or third paragraph of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to one year.
(5)	Business secrets shall be deemed to be documents and data that have been declared by law, statute, rules or other general act or order of a competent body or other authorised person to be an industrial, banking or other business secret and are so important that their disclosure has evidently caused or could cause more serious harmful consequences.

Abuse of an information system

## 237. člen

(1)	Whoever in economic operations unlawfully enters or breaks into an information system or unlawfully uses it by using, modifying, copying, transmitting, destroying or entering any data into an information system, obstructs the transmission of or access to data or obstructs the operation of an information system or unlawfully intercepts data during non-public transmission to an information system, in order to obtain for himself or someone else an unlawful pecuniary benefit or to cause pecuniary damage to another, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	If by the act from the preceding paragraph a large pecuniary benefit was obtained or large pecuniary damage was caused and the perpetrator wanted to obtain such pecuniary benefit for himself or someone else or to cause such pecuniary damage to another, or if it was committed in a criminal organisation or against an information system of a critical infrastructure operator or against an information system of an obliged entity under the law governing information security, he shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.

Abuse of inside information

## 238. člen

(1)	Whoever obtains inside information that could significantly affect the price of a security or other financial instrument admitted to trading on an organised market or other trading venue in the Republic of Slovenia or in at least one Member State of the European Union or for which an application for admission to trading on such a market has been made, regardless of whether the transaction was concluded on that market or outside it, in connection with his position with the issuer of the security or ownership share in the capital of the issuer of the security, his employment or in the performance of an activity and exploits it for himself or for someone else for the direct or indirect acquisition or disposal of that security or other financial instrument or for the cancellation or amendment of an order to trade, if the order was placed before the person had inside information, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	A person who communicates inside information to an unauthorised person or on the basis of inside information recommends to a third person the direct or indirect acquisition or disposal of that security or other financial instrument shall be punished in the same manner.
(3)	A person who obtains inside information without authorisation and exploits it for the direct or indirect acquisition or disposal of that security or other financial instrument for himself or for someone else shall be punished in the same manner as in the first paragraph.
(4)	A person who commits the act from the first paragraph of this Article with securities or other financial instruments on the over-the-counter market, if their price or value depends on or affects the price or value of financial instruments on the markets from the first paragraph of this Article, shall be punished in the same manner as in the first paragraph of this Article.
(5)	If in the acts from the preceding paragraphs the securities or other financial instruments were of great value, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.

Abuse of the market in financial instruments

## 239. člen

(1) Whoever, in order to obtain for himself or someone else an unlawful pecuniary benefit, abuses the market in financial instruments by prohibited conduct, by:
1)	concluding a transaction, issuing an order to trade or otherwise acting in such a way as to give market participants a false or misleading impression regarding the supply, demand or price of a financial instrument or related spot commodity contract, or thereby secures for one or more related persons the price of one or more financial instruments or related spot commodity contracts at an abnormal or artificial level;
2)	using fictitious means or other forms of fraudulent conduct when concluding a transaction or issuing an order to trade;
3)	disseminating false or misleading information about financial instruments or related spot commodity contracts, disseminating rumours and false and misleading news through the media, the internet or in another similar manner with the same aim;
4)	providing false or misleading information or providing false or misleading input data or otherwise acting in such a way as to manipulate the calculation of a benchmark,
shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2) If by the act from the preceding paragraph a large pecuniary benefit was obtained or large pecuniary damage was caused and the perpetrator wanted to obtain such pecuniary benefit for himself or someone else or to cause such pecuniary damage to another, he shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.

Abuse of position or trust in economic activity

## 240. člen

(1)	Whoever in the performance of economic activity abuses his position or trust given, exceeds the rights or omits the duties that he has on the basis of law, other regulation, act of a legal person or legal transaction regarding the disposal of another's property or benefits, their management or representation and thereby obtains for himself or someone else an unlawful pecuniary benefit or causes pecuniary damage, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(2)	If by the act from the preceding paragraph a large pecuniary benefit was obtained or large pecuniary damage was caused and the perpetrator wanted to obtain such pecuniary benefit for himself or someone else or to cause such pecuniary damage to another, he shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(3)	If by the act from the first paragraph of this Article the perpetrator obtained for himself or someone else a non-pecuniary benefit, he shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.

Unlawful acceptance of gifts

heading_path: Opozorilo: Neuradno prečiščeno besedilo predpisa predstavlja zgolj informativni delovni pripomoček, glede katerega organ ne jamči odškodninsko ali kako drugače.
text:
## 241. člen

(1)	Kdor pri opravljanju gospodarske dejavnosti zase ali za koga drugega zahteva ali sprejme nedovoljeno nagrado, darilo ali kakšno drugo korist ali obljubo oziroma ponudbo take koristi, da bi zaradi pridobitve ali ohranitve posla ali druge nedovoljene koristi zanemaril koristi svoje organizacije ali druge fizične osebe ali ji povzročil škodo, se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do šestih let in denarno kaznijo.
(2)	Storilec dejanja iz prejšnjega odstavka, ki zahteva ali sprejme nedovoljeno nagrado, darilo ali kakšno drugo korist ali obljubo oziroma ponudbo take koristi zase ali za koga drugega kot protiuslugo zaradi pridobitve ali ohranitve posla ali druge koristi, se kaznuje za zaporom od treh mesecev do petih let in denarno kaznijo.
(3)	Storilec dejanja iz prvega odstavka tega člena, ki po sklenitvi posla ali opravljeni storitvi ali pridobitvi druge nedovoljene koristi zase ali za koga drugega zahteva ali sprejme nedovoljeno nagrado, darilo ali kakšno drugo korist, se kaznuje z zaporom do štirih let in denarno kaznijo.
(4)	Sprejeta nagrada, darilo ali kakšna druga korist se vzamejo.

Nedovoljeno dajanje daril

## 242. člen

(1)	Kdor osebi, ki opravlja gospodarsko dejavnost, obljubi, ponudi ali da nedovoljeno nagrado, darilo ali kakšno drugo korist zanjo ali za koga drugega, da bi sebi ali komu drugemu pridobil kakšno neupravičeno ugodnost pri pridobitvi ali ohranitvi posla ali druge nedovoljene koristi iz prvega odstavka 241. člena, se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do šestih let in denarno kaznijo.

(2)	Kdor osebi, ki opravlja gospodarsko dejavnost, obljubi, ponudi ali da nedovoljeno nagrado, darilo ali kakšno drugo korist zanjo ali za koga drugega kot protiuslugo za pridobitev ali ohranitev posla ali druge koristi, se kaznuje z zaporom do štirih let in denarno kaznijo.
(3)	Storilcu iz prejšnjih odstavkov, ki je dal nedovoljeno nagrado, darilo ali kakšno drugo korist na zahtevo, pa je dejanje naznanil, preden je bilo odkrito ali preden je izvedel, da je bilo odkrito, se sme kazen odpustiti, če to ne nasprotuje pravilom mednarodnega prava.
(4)	Dana nagrada, darilo ali kakšna druga korist se vzamejo, v primeru iz prejšnjega odstavka pa se smejo vrniti tistemu, ki jih je dal.

Ponarejanje denarja

## 243. člen

(1)	Kdor ponaredi denar, da bi ga spravil v obtok kot pravega, ali kdor spremeni pravi denar, da bi ga spravil v obtok, ali kdor tak ponarejeni denar spravi v obtok, se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do osmih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje kdor uvozi, izvozi, prevaža, prejme ali si drugače preskrbi ponarejen denar, da bi ga spravil v obtok kot pravega.
(3)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor z zakonitimi napravami ali materiali organa, pristojnega za izdajo denarja, denar izdela s kršitvijo pravic ali pogojev, v skladu s katerimi lahko pristojni organi izdajo denar.
(4)	Če gre pri dejanju iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za veliko količino ali veliko premoženjsko vrednost ponarejenega denarja, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(5)	Kdor da v obtok ponarejen denar, ki ga je prejel kot pravega, ali kdor ve, da je bil denar ponarejen ali da je bil tak denar spravljen v obtok, pa tega ne naznani, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do šestih mesecev.
(6)	Ponarejeni denar se vzame.
(7)	Denar je kovan ali papirnat denar, ki je na podlagi zakona v obtoku ali je namenjen v obtok v Republiki Sloveniji ali drugi državi.

Ponarejanje in uporaba ponarejenih vrednotnic ali vrednostnih papirjev

## 244. člen

(1)	Kdor ponaredi kolke ali poštne znamke ali druge vrednotnice ali kdor spremeni kakšno tako pravo vrednotnico, da bi jo uporabil kot pravo ali jo dal v uporabo komu drugemu, ali kdor ponarejene vrednotnice uporabi kot prave ali si jih s tem namenom pridobi, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Kdor ponaredi vrednostne papirje ali kdor spremeni kakšen tak pravi vrednostni papir, da bi ga uporabil kot pravega ali ga dal v uporabo komu drugemu, ali kdor take

ponarejene vrednostne papirje uporabi kot prave ali jih s tem namenom pridobi, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(3)	Če gre pri dejanju iz prejšnjih odstavkov za veliko količino vrednotnic ali vrednostnih papirjev, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(4)	Kdor odstrani žig, s katerim se vrednotnice iz prvega odstavka tega člena uničujejo, ali kdor si kako drugače prizadeva napraviti te vrednotnice, kakor da ne bi bile uporabljene, ali kdor že uporabljene take vrednotnice znova uporabi ali proda, kakor da bi bile veljavne, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(5)	Ponarejene vrednotnice in ponarejeni vrednostni papirji se vzamejo.
(6)	Za vrednotnice po tem zakoniku se štejejo kolki in druge vrednotnice, izdane in v obtoku na podlagi zakona Republike Slovenije, ter tuje vrednotnice.

Pranje denarja

## 245. člen

(1)	Kdor denar ali premoženje, za katero ve, da je bilo pridobljeno s kaznivim dejanjem, sprejme, zamenja, hrani, z njim razpolaga, ga uporabi pri gospodarski dejavnosti ali na drug način, določen z zakonom o preprečevanju pranja denarja, s pranjem zakrije ali poskusi zakriti njegov izvor, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor stori dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka, pa je hkrati storilec ali udeleženec pri kaznivem dejanju, s katerim je bil pridobljen denar ali premoženje iz prejšnjega odstavka.
(3)	Če je denar ali premoženje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena velike vrednosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do osmih let in denarno kaznijo.
(4)	Če je dejanje iz prejšnjih odstavkov storjeno v hudodelski združbi za izvedbo takih dejanj, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let in denarno kaznijo.
(5)	Kdor bi moral in mogel vedeti, da je bil denar ali premoženje pridobljeno s kaznivim dejanjem, pa stori dejanje iz prvega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(6)	Denar in premoženje iz prejšnjih odstavkov se vzameta.

Zloraba negotovinskega plačilnega sredstva

## 246. člen

(1)	Kdor z zlorabo čeka, kreditne ali plačilne kartice ali drugega negotovinskega plačilnega sredstva, ki ga je upravičen uporabljati, banko ali drugega izdajatelja v nasprotju z dogovorom o uporabi tega sredstva zaveže k izplačilu zneska, za katerega ve, da nima kritja na računu, in tako pridobi premoženjsko korist, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Kdor uporabi ček, kreditno ali plačilno kartico ali drugo negotovinsko plačilno sredstvo v izvorni obliki, ki ga ni upravičen uporabljati in je bilo pridobljeno na nezakonit

način, ter s tem sebi ali komu drugemu pridobi protipravno premoženjsko korist, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(3)	Kdor z namenom nezakonite uporabe poseduje, kupi ali drugače pridobi zase ali za drugega, prenese, uvozi, izvozi, proda ali drugače razširi na nezakonit način pridobljeno negotovinsko plačilno sredstvo, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(4)	Če je bila z dejanjem iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena pridobljena večja premoženjska korist, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(5)	Če je bila z dejanjem iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena pridobljena velika premoženjska korist ali če je bilo storjeno v hudodelski združbi, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(6)	Pregon za dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena se začne na predlog.

Uporaba ponarejenega negotovinskega plačilnega sredstva
translated_text:
## 241. člen

(1)	Whoever, in the course of conducting economic activity, for themselves or for another person, demands or accepts an illicit reward, gift or any other benefit or promise or offer of such benefit, in order to neglect the interests of their organisation or another natural person or to cause them damage for the purpose of obtaining or retaining business or other illicit benefit, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to six years and a fine.
(2)	The perpetrator of the act from the preceding paragraph who demands or accepts an illicit reward, gift or any other benefit or promise or offer of such benefit for themselves or for another person as a quid pro quo for obtaining or retaining business or other benefit, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years and a fine.
(3)	The perpetrator of the act from the first paragraph of this Article who, after the conclusion of business or the performance of a service or the obtaining of another illicit benefit, for themselves or for another person, demands or accepts an illicit reward, gift or any other benefit, shall be punished by imprisonment up to four years and a fine.
(4)	The accepted reward, gift or any other benefit shall be confiscated.

Nedovoljeno dajanje daril

## 242. člen

(1)	Whoever promises, offers or gives an illicit reward, gift or any other benefit to a person conducting economic activity, for them or for another person, in order to obtain for themselves or for another person any unjustified advantage in obtaining or retaining business or other illicit benefit from the first paragraph of Article 241, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to six years and a fine.

(2)	Whoever promises, offers or gives an illicit reward, gift or any other benefit to a person conducting economic activity, for them or for another person, as a quid pro quo for obtaining or retaining business or other benefit, shall be punished by imprisonment up to four years and a fine.
(3)	The perpetrator from the preceding paragraphs who gave an illicit reward, gift or any other benefit upon demand, but reported the act before it was discovered or before learning that it had been discovered, may be exempted from punishment if this does not conflict with the rules of international law.
(4)	The given reward, gift or any other benefit shall be confiscated, but in the case from the preceding paragraph they may be returned to the person who gave them.

Ponarejanje denarja

## 243. člen

(1)	Whoever counterfeits money in order to put it into circulation as genuine, or whoever alters genuine money in order to put it into circulation, or whoever puts such counterfeit money into circulation, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to eight years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever imports, exports, transports, receives or otherwise procures counterfeit money in order to put it into circulation as genuine.
(3)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever, using lawful devices or materials of the authority competent for issuing money, produces money in violation of the rights or conditions under which the competent authorities may issue money.
(4)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this Article involves a large quantity or large property value of counterfeit money, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(5)	Whoever puts into circulation counterfeit money which they received as genuine, or whoever knows that money has been counterfeited or that such money has been put into circulation but fails to report it, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to six months.
(6)	Counterfeit money shall be confiscated.
(7)	Money is coined or paper money which is in circulation by law or is intended for circulation in the Republic of Slovenia or another state.

Ponarejanje in uporaba ponarejenih vrednotnic ali vrednostnih papirjev

## 244. člen

(1)	Whoever counterfeits stamps or postage stamps or other securities or whoever alters any such genuine security in order to use it as genuine or give it for use to another person, or whoever uses counterfeit securities as genuine or procures them for that purpose, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
(2)	Whoever counterfeits valuable papers or whoever alters any such genuine valuable paper in order to use it as genuine or give it for use to another person, or whoever uses such

counterfeit valuable papers as genuine or procures them for that purpose, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(3)	If the act from the preceding paragraphs involves a large quantity of securities or valuable papers, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(4)	Whoever removes a stamp by which securities from the first paragraph of this Article are cancelled, or whoever otherwise endeavours to make these securities appear as if they had not been used, or whoever reuses or sells such already used securities as if they were valid, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(5)	Counterfeit securities and counterfeit valuable papers shall be confiscated.
(6)	For the purposes of this Code, securities are stamps and other securities issued and in circulation pursuant to the law of the Republic of Slovenia, as well as foreign securities.

Pranje denarja

## 245. člen

(1)	Whoever accepts, exchanges, stores, disposes of, uses in economic activity or in any other manner specified by the law on the prevention of money laundering, money or property which they know was obtained through a criminal offence, and by laundering conceals or attempts to conceal its origin, shall be punished by imprisonment up to five years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever commits the act from the preceding paragraph and is simultaneously the perpetrator or participant in the criminal offence by which the money or property from the preceding paragraph was obtained.
(3)	If the money or property from the first or second paragraph of this Article is of large value, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment up to eight years and a fine.
(4)	If the act from the preceding paragraphs was committed in a criminal organisation for the execution of such acts, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years and a fine.
(5)	Whoever should have and could have known that the money or property was obtained through a criminal offence, and commits the act from the first or third paragraph of this Article, shall be punished by imprisonment up to two years.
(6)	The money and property from the preceding paragraphs shall be confiscated.

Zloraba negotovinskega plačilnega sredstva

## 246. člen

(1)	Whoever, by misusing a cheque, credit or payment card or other non-cash means of payment which they are authorised to use, obliges a bank or other issuer, contrary to the agreement on the use of that means, to pay an amount which they know is not covered by the account, and thereby obtains a property benefit, shall be punished by imprisonment up to two years.
(2)	Whoever uses a cheque, credit or payment card or other non-cash means of payment in its original form, which they are not authorised to use and which was obtained in an unlawful

manner, and thereby obtains for themselves or for another person an unlawful property benefit, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
(3)	Whoever, with the intention of unlawful use, possesses, purchases or otherwise procures for themselves or for another person, transfers, imports, exports, sells or otherwise distributes an unlawfully obtained non-cash means of payment, shall be punished by imprisonment up to one year.
(4)	If a larger property benefit was obtained by the act from the first, second or third paragraph of this Article, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment up to five years.
(5)	If a large property benefit was obtained by the act from the first, second or third paragraph of this Article or if it was committed in a criminal organisation, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(6)	Prosecution for the act from the first paragraph of this Article shall be initiated upon proposal.

Uporaba ponarejenega negotovinskega plačilnega sredstva

text:
## 247. člen

(1)	Kdor namesti na bančni avtomat ali aparat za vplačila s kartico napravo za preslikavanje podatkov plačilnih, kreditnih ali drugih kartic ali drugega negotovinskega plačilnega sredstva ali njihove podatke pridobi zase ali za drugega na celotnem medmrežju ali na drug način ali negotovinsko plačilno sredstvo ponaredi, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor uporabi ponarejeno plačilno, kreditno ali drugo kartico ali drugo negotovinsko plačilno sredstvo ali njihove podatke in si pridobi premoženjsko korist.
(3)	Kdor z namenom nezakonite uporabe poseduje, kupi, prenese, uvozi, izvozi, proda ali drugače razširi ponarejeno negotovinsko plačilno sredstvo ali njegove podatke, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(4)	Če je bila z dejanjem iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena pridobljena velika premoženjska korist ali če je bilo storjeno v hudodelski združbi, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.

Izdelava, pridobitev in odtujitev pripomočkov za ponarejanje

## 248. člen

(1)	Kdor izdela, hrani, prenese, si pridobi, proda ali da v uporabo pripomočke za ponarejanje denarja, vrednotnic, vrednostnih papirjev ali zaščitne elemente, ki so namenjeni za zaščito pred ponarejanjem, ali napravo za preslikavanje zapisa kreditne, plačilne ali druge kartice ali drugega negotovinskega plačilnega sredstva, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Pripomočki za ponarejanje se vzamejo.
(3)	Poskus kaznivega dejanja iz prvega odstavka tega člena je kazniv.

Davčna zatajitev

## 249. člen

(1)	Kdor z enim ali več ravnanji, zato da bi se sam ali kdo drug popolnoma ali deloma izognil plačilu davkov, prispevkov ali drugih predpisanih obveznosti fizičnih ali pravnih oseb ali neupravičeno dobil v celoti ali deloma vrnjen davek v Republiki Sloveniji ali drugih državah članicah Evropske unije, da lažne podatke o pridobljenih dohodkih, stroških, predmetih, blagu ali drugih okoliščinah, ki vplivajo na ugotovitev davkov in drugih predpisanih obveznosti, ali kako drugače preslepi organ, pristojen za odmero ali nadzor nad obračunavanjem in plačevanjem teh obveznosti, pa skupna višina neporavnanih obveznosti ali obveznosti, ki se jim je izogibal, ali davka, ki mu je bil neupravičeno vrnjen, ne glede na vrsto obveznosti ali davka v obdobju največ dvanajstih zaporednih mesecev, doseže veliko premoženjsko vrednost, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor z namenom iz prejšnjega odstavka enkrat ali večkrat ne prijavi pridobljenega dohodka ali drugih okoliščin, ki vplivajo na ugotovitev davkov, prispevkov ali drugih predpisanih obveznosti fizičnih ali pravnih oseb, kadar je prijava obvezna, pa skupna višina neporavnanih obveznosti ali obveznosti, ki se jim je izogibal, ne glede na vrsto obveznosti v obdobju največ dvanajstih zaporednih mesecev, doseže veliko premoženjsko vrednost.
(3)	Kdor z namenom, da bi preprečil ugotovitev dejanske davčne obveznosti, na zahtevo pristojnega davčnega organa ne daje podatkov, ne vodi ali ne predloži poslovnih knjig in evidenc, ki jih je dolžan voditi, ali so knjige in evidence vsebinsko napačne, ali ne da pojasnil v zvezi s predmetom davčnega nadzora ali ovira davčni nadzor, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(4)	Če je bilo dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena storjeno v hudodelski združbi, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od treh do dvanajstih let.

Tihotapstvo

## 250. člen

(1)	Kdor prenese, izogibajoč se ukrepom carinskega nadzorstva, čez carinsko črto Evropske unije blago velike premoženjske vrednosti, ali ga prenese z uporabo sile ali grožnje, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let in denarno kaznijo.
(2)	Kdor se ukvarja s prenašanjem blaga na carinsko območje Evropske unije in se pri tem izogiba ukrepom carinskega nadzorstva, ga po njem prevaža, nudi skrivališča ali skladišča, ga ponuja ali doseže prodajo, pa gre za blago, ki skupaj dosega večjo premoženjsko vrednost, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let zapora in denarno kaznijo.
(3)	S kaznijo iz prejšnjega odstavka se kaznuje uradna oseba, ki z zlorabo uradnega položaja ali pravic omogoči tihotapstvo blaga na carinsko območje Evropske unije ali prevoz po njem.
(4)	Če storilec z dejanji iz drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena sebi ali komu drugemu pridobi veliko premoženjsko korist ali povzroči nevarnost za življenje ali zdravje ljudi ali podpira teroristično dejavnost ali taka dejanja stori kot član hudodelske združbe, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh do petnajstih let in z denarno kaznijo.
(5)	Kdor pridobiva ali zbira tihotapsko blago velike premoženjske vrednosti za prenos na carinsko območje Evropske unije, preskrbuje ponarejene dokumente ali prevoz na

in po carinskem območju Evropske unije ali kako drugače organizira skrivanje, skladiščenje ali prodajo tihotapskega blaga, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh do dvanajstih let in denarno kaznijo.
(6)	Prejšnji odstavki se uporabljajo tudi za kazniva dejanja, storjena v tujini, če je država, v kateri so bila storjena, enako kot Republika Slovenija sprejela skupno mednarodnopravno obveznost preprečevati taka kazniva dejanja, ne glede na to, kje so storjena, ter je dejanja v svojem zakonu ustrezno enako določila kot kazniva dejanja.
(7)	Vrednost blaga po tem členu se določa po njegovi tržni vrednosti na območju Republike Slovenije.
(8)	Tihotapsko blago se vzame.

Petindvajseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER PRAVNI PROMET

Ponarejanje listin

## 251. člen

(1)	Kdor ponaredi listino ali spremeni pravo listino, zato da bi se taka listina uporabila kot prava, ali kdor ponarejeno ali spremenjeno listino uporabi kot pravo, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Poskus je kazniv.
(3)	Kdor ponaredi javno listino, oporoko, javno ali uradno knjigo ali kakšno drugo knjigo, ki se mora voditi na podlagi zakona, spremeni tako pravo listino ali kdor tako ponarejeno ali spremenjeno listino hrani zaradi uporabe ali jo uporabi kot pravo, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Posebni primeri ponarejanja listin

## 252. člen

(1) Za ponarejanje listin se kaznuje po prvem odstavku, če gre za listino iz tretjega odstavka prejšnjega člena, pa po tretjem odstavku prejšnjega člena:
1)	kdor kakšen papir, golico ali kakšno drugo listino, ki jo je kdo podpisal, neupravičeno izpolni s kakšno izjavo, ki ima pomen za pravna razmerja;
2)	kdor koga preslepi o vsebini kakšne listine in jo ta podpiše, misleč, da se podpisuje pod kakšno drugo listino ali pod kakšno drugo vsebino;
3)	kdor izda listino v imenu kakšne osebe brez njenega pooblastila ali v imenu osebe, ki je ni;
4)	kdor kot izdajatelj listine doda k svojemu podpisu kakšen položaj ali naziv, čeprav nima takega položaja ali naziva, pa to bistveno vpliva na dokazilno moč listine;
5)	kdor napravi listino tako, da neupravičeno uporabi pravi pečat ali znamenje.
(2) S kaznijo iz tretjega odstavka prejšnjega člena se kaznuje, kdor kot tržno blago napravi za drugega doktorsko disertacijo, magistrsko, diplomsko, izpitno, maturitetno ali

seminarsko nalogo ali sestavi za drugega kakšno drugo pisno nalogo, potrebno za pridobitev izobrazbe, ali kdor tako nalogo uporabi kot svojo.

Overitev lažne vsebine

## 253. člen

(1)	Kdor spravi pristojni organ ali notarja v zmoto in s tem doseže, da ta v javni listini, zapisniku, knjigi ali poslovni listini potrdi kar koli lažnega, kar naj bi bil dokaz v pravnem prometu, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje tudi, kdor uporabi javno listino, zapisnik, knjigo ali poslovno listino iz prejšnjega odstavka, čeprav ve, da je lažna.

Nezakonito dajanje pravne pomoči

## 254. člen

(1)	Kdor se brez ustrezne izobrazbe ali brez ustreznih izpolnjenih pogojev za plačilo ukvarja s tem, da v sodnih ali upravnih postopkih daje pravno pomoč, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali z zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Pridobljena premoženjska korist se vzame.

Izdaja in uporaba lažnega zdravniškega ali veterinarskega spričevala

## 247. člen

(1)	Whoever installs on a bank ATM or card payment terminal a device for copying data from payment, credit or other cards or other non-cash means of payment, or obtains such data for themselves or for another on the entire internet or in another manner, or counterfeits a non-cash means of payment, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever uses a counterfeit payment, credit or other card or other non-cash means of payment or their data and thereby obtains a pecuniary benefit.
(3)	Whoever, with the intention of unlawful use, possesses, purchases, transfers, imports, exports, sells or otherwise distributes a counterfeit non-cash means of payment or its data, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to one year.
(4)	If a large pecuniary benefit was obtained by an act under the first, second or third paragraph of this Article, or if it was committed within a criminal organisation, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.

Manufacture, acquisition and disposal of counterfeiting instruments

## 248. člen

(1)	Whoever manufactures, stores, transfers, acquires, sells or makes available for use instruments for counterfeiting money, securities, valuable papers or security elements intended for protection against counterfeiting, or a device for copying the record of a credit, payment or other card or other non-cash means of payment, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.
(2)	Instruments for counterfeiting shall be confiscated.
(3)	An attempt to commit the criminal offence under the first paragraph of this Article is punishable.

Tax evasion

## 249. člen

(1)	Whoever, by one or more acts, in order that they themselves or another person wholly or partially evade payment of taxes, contributions or other prescribed obligations of natural or legal persons, or unlawfully obtain in whole or in part a refund of tax in the Republic of Slovenia or other Member States of the European Union, provides false information about acquired income, expenses, objects, goods or other circumstances affecting the determination of taxes and other prescribed obligations, or otherwise deceives the authority competent for assessment or supervision of the calculation and payment of these obligations, and the total amount of outstanding obligations or obligations evaded, or tax unlawfully refunded, regardless of the type of obligation or tax in a period of no more than twelve consecutive months, reaches a large pecuniary value, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever, with the intention from the preceding paragraph, once or repeatedly fails to declare acquired income or other circumstances affecting the determination of taxes, contributions or other prescribed obligations of natural or legal persons, where declaration is mandatory, and the total amount of outstanding obligations or obligations evaded, regardless of the type of obligation in a period of no more than twelve consecutive months, reaches a large pecuniary value.
(3)	Whoever, with the intention of preventing the determination of actual tax liability, upon request of the competent tax authority, does not provide information, does not keep or does not submit business books and records that they are obliged to keep, or the books and records are substantively incorrect, or does not provide explanations in connection with the subject of tax supervision or obstructs tax supervision, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.
(4)	If the act under the first or second paragraph of this Article was committed within a criminal organisation, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three to twelve years.

Smuggling

## 250. člen

(1)	Whoever transports, while evading customs supervision measures, across the customs line of the European Union goods of large pecuniary value, or transports them using force or threat, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years and a fine.
(2)	Whoever engages in transporting goods into the customs territory of the European Union while evading customs supervision measures, transports them within it, provides hiding places or storage, offers them or achieves their sale, where the goods together reach a greater pecuniary value, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years and a fine.
(3)	The punishment from the preceding paragraph shall apply to an official who, by abuse of official position or rights, enables the smuggling of goods into the customs territory of the European Union or transport within it.
(4)	If the perpetrator, by acts under the second or third paragraph of this Article, obtains for themselves or another person a large pecuniary benefit or causes danger to human life or health or supports terrorist activity, or commits such acts as a member of a criminal organisation, they shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years and a fine.
(5)	Whoever acquires or collects smuggled goods of large pecuniary value for transport into the customs territory of the European Union, procures counterfeit documents or transport to

and within the customs territory of the European Union, or otherwise organises the concealment, storage or sale of smuggled goods, shall be punished by imprisonment from three to twelve years and a fine.
(6)	The preceding paragraphs shall also apply to criminal offences committed abroad if the state in which they were committed, like the Republic of Slovenia, has accepted a common international legal obligation to prevent such criminal offences regardless of where they are committed, and has correspondingly defined the acts in its law as criminal offences.
(7)	The value of goods under this Article shall be determined according to their market value in the territory of the Republic of Slovenia.
(8)	Smuggled goods shall be confiscated.

Chapter Twenty-Five
CRIMINAL OFFENCES AGAINST LEGAL TRANSACTIONS

Forgery of documents

## 251. člen

(1)	Whoever forges a document or alters a genuine document in order that such document be used as genuine, or whoever uses a forged or altered document as genuine, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.
(2)	An attempt is punishable.
(3)	Whoever forges a public document, a will, a public or official book or any other book that must be kept pursuant to law, alters such a genuine document, or whoever keeps such a forged or altered document for use or uses it as genuine, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.

Special cases of forgery of documents

## 252. člen

(1) Forgery of documents shall be punished under the first paragraph, or if it concerns a document from the third paragraph of the preceding Article, under the third paragraph of the preceding Article:
1)	whoever unlawfully fills in any paper, blank or any other document that someone has signed with any statement that has significance for legal relations;
2)	whoever deceives someone about the content of any document and they sign it, thinking that they are signing some other document or some other content;
3)	whoever issues a document in the name of any person without their authorisation or in the name of a person who does not exist;
4)	whoever, as the issuer of a document, adds to their signature any position or title, even though they do not have such position or title, and this substantially affects the evidentiary force of the document;
5)	whoever makes a document by unlawfully using a genuine seal or sign.
(2) The punishment from the third paragraph of the preceding Article shall apply to whoever makes as commercial goods for another person a doctoral dissertation, master's, diploma, examination, secondary school leaving examination or

seminar paper, or composes for another person any other written assignment necessary for obtaining education, or whoever uses such an assignment as their own.

Certification of false content

## 253. člen

(1)	Whoever misleads the competent authority or notary and thereby achieves that they certify in a public document, record, book or business document anything false that is to serve as proof in legal transactions, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	The same punishment shall also apply to whoever uses a public document, record, book or business document from the preceding paragraph, even though they know it is false.

Unlawful provision of legal assistance

## 254. člen

(1)	Whoever, without appropriate education or without appropriately fulfilled conditions, engages for payment in providing legal assistance in judicial or administrative proceedings, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.
(2)	The acquired pecuniary benefit shall be confiscated.

## 255. člen

(1)	Zdravnik, ki zavestno izda lažno zdravniško spričevalo ali drugo zdravniško potrdilo, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor zavestno uporabi zdravniško spričevalo ali potrdilo iz prejšnjega odstavka.
(3)	Veterinar, ki zavestno izda lažno veterinarsko spričevalo, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(4)	Enako kot v prejšnjem odstavku se kaznuje, kdor zavestno uporabi spričevalo iz prejšnjega odstavka.

Ponarejanje znamenj za zaznamovanje blaga, mer in uteži

## 256. člen

(1)	Kdor, zato da bi jih uporabil kot prave, ponaredi znamenja za zaznamovanje domačega ali tujega blaga, kot so pečati, žigi, znamke ali druge predpisane oznake, s katerimi se zaznamujejo zlato, srebro, živina, les ali kakšno drugo blago, ali prava taka

znamenja spremeni ali odstrani ali uporabi ponarejena znamenja kot prava, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor ponaredi mere ali uteži ali kdor jih uporabi pri merjenju
kot prave.
(3)	Kdor neupravičeno izdela, si pridobi, proda ali da v uporabo pripomočke za
izdelovanje znamenj za zaznamovanje ali označevanje blaga kakor tudi ponarejene mere in uteži, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(4)	Ponarejena znamenja, mere in uteži kakor tudi pripomočki za njihovo ponarejanje se vzamejo.

Šestindvajseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER URADNO DOLŽNOST, JAVNA POOBLASTILA IN JAVNA SREDSTVA

Zloraba uradnega položaja ali uradnih pravic

## 257. člen

(1)	Uradna oseba ali javni uslužbenec, ki izrabi svoj položaj ali prestopi meje uradnih pravic ali ne opravi uradne dolžnosti in s tem sebi ali komu drugemu pridobi kakšno nepremoženjsko korist ali komu prizadene škodo, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Če storilec z dejanjem iz prejšnjega odstavka povzroči večjo škodo ali huje prekrši pravice drugega, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(3)	Uradna oseba ali javni uslužbenec, ki izrabi svoj uradni položaj ali prestopi meje uradnih pravic ali ne opravi uradne dolžnosti in s tem sebi ali komu drugemu pridobi protipravno premoženjsko korist, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh mesecev do petih let.
(4)	Enako kot v prejšnjem odstavku se kaznuje storilec iz prejšnjega odstavka, ki izkoristi svoj položaj ali vpliv za nezakonito povečanje lastnega premoženja v večji vrednosti.
(5)	Če je storilec z dejanjem iz tretjega in četrtega odstavka pridobil sebi ali komu drugemu veliko protipravno premoženjsko korist in je hotel pridobiti tako korist, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.

257.a	člen
Oškodovanje javnih sredstev
(1)	Uradna oseba, javni uslužbenec ali druga pooblaščena oseba uporabnika javnih sredstev, ki pri naročanju, pridobivanju, upravljanju teh sredstev ali razpolaganju z njimi, zavestno krši predpise, opušča dolžno nadzorstvo ali kako drugače povzroči ali omogoči nezakonito ali nenamensko uporabo javnih sredstev, čeprav predvideva ali bi morala in mogla predvidevati, da lahko za javna sredstva zaradi tega nastane večja premoženjska škoda, in ta res nastane, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh mesecev do petih let in z denarno kaznijo.
(2)	Če je zaradi dejanja iz prejšnjega odstavka nastala velika premoženjska škoda, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let in z denarno kaznijo.

(3)	Uporabnik javnih sredstev po tem členu je pravna oseba javnega prava ali njena enota ali pravna oseba zasebnega prava ali zasebnik, če s temi sredstvi ali na njihov račun izvaja javno službo ali druge dejavnosti v javnem interesu ali zagotavlja javne dobrine na podlagi koncesije ali druge izključne ali posebne pravice.
(4)	Javna sredstva po tem členu so nepremičnine, premičnine, denarna sredstva, terjatve, kapitalske naložbe in druge oblike finančnega premoženja države, samoupravne lokalne skupnosti, Evropske unije ali druge pravne osebe javnega prava.

Nevestno delo v službi

## 258. člen

Uradna oseba ali javni uslužbenec, ki zavestno krši zakone ali druge predpise, opušča svoje nadzorstvo ali kako drugače očitno nevestno ravna v službi, čeprav predvideva ali bi morala in mogla predvidevati, da lahko nastane zaradi tega hujša kršitev pravic drugega ali škoda na javni dobrini ali premoženjska škoda, in res nastane kršitev oziroma večja škoda, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do treh let.

Ponareditev ali uničenje uradne listine, knjige, spisa ali arhivskega gradiva

## 259. člen

(1)	Uradna oseba, ki v uradno listino, knjigo, ali spis vpiše lažne podatke ali ne vpiše kakšnega pomembnega podatka ali s svojim podpisom oziroma pečatom potrdi uradno listino, knjigo ali spis z lažno vsebino ali s svojim podpisom oziroma uradnim pečatom omogoči sestavo uradne listine, knjige ali spisa z lažno vsebino, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje tudi uradna oseba, ki uradno listino, knjigo ali spis z lažno vsebino uporabi v službi kot resnične ali ki uradno listino, knjigo ali spis uniči, skrije, jih precej poškoduje ali kako drugače napravi neuporabne.
(3)	Kdor protipravno odtuji, uniči ali prikriva arhivsko gradivo, ali ga napravi neuporabnega, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh mesecev do treh let.

Izdaja tajnih podatkov

## 260. člen

(1)	Uradna oseba ali druga oseba, ki v nasprotju s svojimi dolžnostmi varovanja tajnih podatkov sporoči ali izroči komu tajne podatke ali mu kako drugače omogoči, da pride do njih, ali zbira take podatke, zato da jih izroči nepoklicani osebi, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor protipravno pride do tajnih podatkov, da bi jih neupravičeno uporabil, kakor tudi, kdor take podatke brez dovoljenja javno objavi.
(3)	Oseba, ki izpolni znake kaznivega dejanja iz prvega odstavka tega člena, se ne kaznuje, če gre za tajni podatek, ki razkriva protipraven poseg v človekove pravice ali

temeljne svoboščine, druge ustavne ali zakonske pravice, hujše zlorabe oblasti ali pooblastil ali druge hujše nepravilnosti pri izvrševanju oblasti, javnih pooblastil ali opravljanju javne službe, dejanje pa ni storjeno iz koristoljubnosti in ne ogroža življenja ljudi ali nima hujših ali nepopravljivih škodljivih posledic za varnost ali zakonsko varovane interese Republike Slovenije.
(4)	Ne glede na določbo drugega odstavka tega člena se ne kaznuje, kdor tajni podatek javno objavi, pridobi, posreduje ali poseduje z namenom razkritja javnosti, če glede na okoliščine primera javni interes po razkritju tajnega podatka prevlada nad javnim interesom po ohranitvi njegove tajnosti, in če z dejanjem ni neposredno ogroženo življenje ene ali več oseb.
(5)	Če je dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena izvršeno iz koristoljubnosti ali je bilo z objavo neposredno ogroženo življenje ljudi ali je imela objava hujše ali nepopravljive škodljive posledice za varnost ali zakonsko varovane interese Republike Slovenije, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do osmih let.
(6)	Če je dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.

translated_text:
## 255. člen

(1)	A physician who knowingly issues a false medical certificate or other medical document shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	Anyone who knowingly uses a medical certificate or document from the preceding paragraph shall be punished in the same manner.
(3)	A veterinarian who knowingly issues a false veterinary certificate shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.
(4)	Anyone who knowingly uses a certificate from the preceding paragraph shall be punished in the same manner as in the preceding paragraph.

Ponarejanje znamenj za zaznamovanje blaga, mer in uteži

## 256. člen

(1)	Anyone who, in order to use them as genuine, counterfeits marks for marking domestic or foreign goods, such as seals, stamps, brands or other prescribed markings with which gold, silver, livestock, timber or any other goods are marked, or alters or removes genuine such

marks or uses counterfeit marks as genuine, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to two years.
(2)	Anyone who counterfeits measures or weights or who uses them in measuring as genuine shall be punished in the same manner.
(3)	Anyone who unlawfully manufactures, acquires, sells or puts into use devices for producing marks for marking or designating goods as well as counterfeit measures and weights shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.
(4)	Counterfeit marks, measures and weights as well as devices for their counterfeiting shall be confiscated.

Šestindvajseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER URADNO DOLŽNOST, JAVNA POOBLASTILA IN JAVNA SREDSTVA

Zloraba uradnega položaja ali uradnih pravic

## 257. člen

(1)	An official person or public employee who abuses their position or exceeds the limits of official powers or fails to perform an official duty and thereby obtains any non-pecuniary benefit for themselves or another person or causes damage to someone, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.
(2)	If the perpetrator causes greater damage or more seriously violates the rights of another by the act from the preceding paragraph, they shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(3)	An official person or public employee who abuses their official position or exceeds the limits of official powers or fails to perform an official duty and thereby obtains an unlawful pecuniary benefit for themselves or another person, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.
(4)	The perpetrator from the preceding paragraph who exploits their position or influence to unlawfully increase their own property of greater value shall be punished in the same manner as in the preceding paragraph.
(5)	If the perpetrator obtained a large unlawful pecuniary benefit for themselves or another person by the act from the third and fourth paragraphs and intended to obtain such benefit, they shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.

257.a	člen
Oškodovanje javnih sredstev
(1)	An official person, public employee or other authorised person of a user of public funds who, in procuring, acquiring, managing these funds or disposing of them, knowingly violates regulations, omits due supervision or otherwise causes or enables unlawful or improper use of public funds, although they foresee or should and could have foreseen that greater pecuniary damage to public funds may occur as a result, and such damage does occur, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years and by a fine.
(2)	If large pecuniary damage occurred as a result of the act from the preceding paragraph, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years and by a fine.

(3)	A user of public funds under this article is a legal person under public law or its unit or a legal person under private law or a private individual, if they use these funds or at their expense perform a public service or other activities in the public interest or provide public goods on the basis of a concession or other exclusive or special right.
(4)	Public funds under this article are immovable property, movable property, monetary funds, receivables, capital investments and other forms of financial assets of the state, self-governing local community, the European Union or other legal person under public law.

Nevestno delo v službi

## 258. člen

An official person or public employee who knowingly violates laws or other regulations, omits their supervision or otherwise manifestly acts negligently in service, although they foresee or should and could have foreseen that a more serious violation of the rights of another or damage to a public good or pecuniary damage may occur as a result, and such violation or greater damage does occur, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to three years.

Ponareditev ali uničenje uradne listine, knjige, spisa ali arhivskega gradiva

## 259. člen

(1)	An official person who enters false data in an official document, book or file or fails to enter any important data or with their signature or seal certifies an official document, book or file with false content or with their signature or official seal enables the composition of an official document, book or file with false content, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	An official person who uses an official document, book or file with false content in service as genuine or who destroys, conceals, considerably damages or otherwise renders unusable an official document, book or file, shall be punished in the same manner.
(3)	Anyone who unlawfully alienates, destroys or conceals archival material, or renders it unusable, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to three years.

Izdaja tajnih podatkov

## 260. člen

(1)	An official person or other person who, contrary to their duties of protecting classified information, communicates or hands over classified information to someone or otherwise enables them to obtain it, or collects such information in order to hand it over to an unauthorised person, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	Anyone who unlawfully obtains classified information in order to use it without authorisation, as well as anyone who publicly discloses such information without permission, shall be punished in the same manner.
(3)	A person who fulfils the elements of the criminal offence from the first paragraph of this article shall not be punished if it concerns classified information that reveals an unlawful interference with human rights or

fundamental freedoms, other constitutional or statutory rights, serious abuses of authority or powers or other serious irregularities in the exercise of authority, public powers or performance of public service, and the act was not committed out of self-interest and does not endanger people's lives or have more serious or irreparable harmful consequences for the security or legally protected interests of the Republic of Slovenia.
(4)	Notwithstanding the provision of the second paragraph of this article, anyone who publicly discloses, acquires, transmits or possesses classified information with the intention of disclosure to the public shall not be punished if, according to the circumstances of the case, the public interest in disclosing the classified information prevails over the public interest in maintaining its secrecy, and if the act does not directly endanger the life of one or more persons.
(5)	If the act from the first paragraph of this article was committed out of self-interest or if people's lives were directly endangered by the disclosure or if the disclosure had more serious or irreparable harmful consequences for the security or legally protected interests of the Republic of Slovenia, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to eight years.
(6)	If the act from the first paragraph of this article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.

Jemanje podkupnine
