Povzročitev splošne nevarnosti

## 314. člen

(1)	Kdor s požarom, povodnjo, eksplozijo, strupom ali strupenim plinom, ionizirajočim sevanjem, motorno silo, električno ali kakšno drugo energijo ali kakšnim drugim splošno nevarnim dejanjem ali sredstvom ali opustitvijo dejanja, ki bi ga moral storiti za zagotovitev splošne varnosti ljudi in premoženja, povzroči nevarnost za življenje ljudi ali premoženje velike vrednosti, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Kdor z eksplozivom ali drugim nevarnim dejanjem in sredstvom, z namenom izsiljevanja, zastraševanja, prisiljenja k storitvi ali opustitvi nekega drugega dejanja, maščevanja ali pridobitve premoženjske ali nepremoženjske koristi sebi ali komu drugemu, načrtuje, poskusi ali izvede nevarno dejanje, pri katerem je ali bi bila ogrožena varnost ljudi ali premoženja večje vrednosti, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(3)	Kdor stori dejanje iz prvega odstavka iz malomarnosti, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ene ali več oseb ali veliko premoženjsko škodo, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega in drugega odstavka z zaporom do desetih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka pa z zaporom do petih let.

(5)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega odstavka z zaporom od enega do petnajstih let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka z zaporom najmanj petnajstih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka pa z zaporom do osmih let.

Povzročitev nevarnosti pri gradbeni dejavnosti

## 315. člen

(1)	Oseba, ki je odgovorna za načrtovanje ali nadzor načrtov za pripravo ali vodenje zidave ali gradbenih del, pa pri tem ravna v nasprotju s predpisi ali splošno priznanimi tehničnimi pravili in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje ljudi ali premoženje velike vrednosti, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Če je dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ene ali več oseb ali veliko premoženjsko škodo, se storilec za dejanje iz prvega odstavka kaznuje z zaporom od enega do petih let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka pa z zaporom do treh let.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec za dejanje iz prvega odstavka kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka pa z zaporom do osmih let.

## 316. člen (črtan)

Ogrožanje okolja s hrupom ali svetlobo

## 317. člen

(1)	Kdor s kršitvijo predpisov povzroča čezmeren hrup ali premočno osvetlitev, s katero se lahko povzročijo hujše okvare zdravja ljudi, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Če je dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

Poškodovanje ali uničenje javnih naprav

## 318. člen

(1)	Kdor uniči, poškoduje ali odstrani električne vode, plinovode, vodovode, toplovode, naftovode, telekomunikacijske naprave, podmorske kable, kanalizacijske naprave in naprave za varstvo okolja ali druge podobne javne naprave in tako povzroči motnje v preskrbi prebivalstva ali gospodarstva, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.

(2)	Če je dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

Prevažanje ali prenašanje razstreliva ali nevarnih snovi v nasprotju s predpisi

## 319. člen

Kdor v nasprotju s predpisi o prometu z razstrelivom ali lahko vnetljivimi snovmi ali z drugimi nevarnimi snovmi ali nevarnimi odpadki prevaža, odda za prevoz z javnim prometnim sredstvom take snovi ali jih sam prenaša, ko uporablja javno prevozno sredstvo, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

Zloraba telekomunikacijskih znamenj

## 320. člen

Kdor zavestno brez potrebe odda mednarodno dogovorjeno znamenje klica na pomoč ali znamenje, da mu grozi nevarnost, ali kdor s telekomunikacijskim znamenjem preslepi, da je dana varnost, ali kdor kako drugače zlorabi mednarodno dogovorjeno telekomunikacijsko znamenje, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

Neodvrnitev nevarnosti

## 321. člen

(1)	Kdor ne naznani pravočasno pristojnemu organu ali organizaciji ali sicer ne stori vsega, kar je potrebno, da se odvrne požar, povodenj, eksplozija, prometna nesreča, ekološka nesreča ali kakšna druga nevarnost za življenje ljudi ali čezmerno obremenitev okolja ali premoženje večje vrednosti, čeprav bi to lahko storil brez nevarnosti zase ali za koga drugega, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Kdor komu s silo, grožnjo ali preslepitvijo prepreči, da bi storil, kar je potrebno, da se odvrne nevarnost za življenje ljudi, okolje ali premoženje večje vrednosti, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.

Odklonitev sodelovanja pri odvračanju splošne nevarnosti

## 322. člen

Kdor v nasprotju z odredbo pristojnega organa ali organizacije brez upravičenega razloga ne sodeluje pri odvračanju splošne nevarnosti ali odpravljanju posledic, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do šestih mesecev.

Enaintrideseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER VARNOST JAVNEGA PROMETA

Povzročitev prometne nesreče iz malomarnosti
translated_text:
## 309. člen

(1)	Whoever misuses a sign for help or a sign for danger or unjustifiably calls for help or falsely reports that danger is imminent and thereby causes state authorities or other competent organisations to take action without need or to use the means of the protection, rescue and assistance system without justification, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	If the act from the preceding paragraph prevented or obstructed the work of judicial or other state authorities and thereby prevented the performance of an official act or caused major property damage, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.

Samovoljnost

## 310. člen

(1)	Whoever arbitrarily takes his own right or a right which he believes belongs to him, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to six months.
(2)	Whoever arbitrarily takes his own right or a right which he believes belongs to him, by using force or serious threat of attack on life or body, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.
(3)	The same as in the preceding paragraph shall be punished whoever commits the act from the preceding paragraph for another person.
(4)	Whoever for himself or another person collects a debt by the act from the second paragraph of this Article, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(5)	Prosecution for the act from the first paragraph of this Article shall be initiated by private action, and for the acts from the second and third paragraphs upon proposal.

Oviranje verskih obredov

## 311. člen

Whoever obstructs, prevents or disturbs a religious ceremony or whoever behaves insultingly at a place intended for this purpose, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.

Oviranje pogreba in skrunitev groba

## 312. člen

(1)	Whoever obstructs, prevents or disturbs a funeral, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.
(2)	The same shall be punished whoever without authorisation digs up or tears open a grave or any other place where the dead are buried, or otherwise seriously desecrates it.
(3)	If the acts from the preceding paragraphs are committed by two or more persons or if two or more graves have been desecrated, they shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.

Skrunitev trupla

## 313. člen

Whoever without authorisation hides, carries away, damages, destroys or otherwise desecrates a corpse, part of a corpse or mortal remains, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.

Trideseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER SPLOŠNO VARNOST LJUDI IN PREMOŽENJA

Povzročitev splošne nevarnosti

## 314. člen

(1)	Whoever by fire, flood, explosion, poison or poisonous gas, ionising radiation, motor power, electrical or any other energy or any other generally dangerous act or means or by omission of an act which he should have committed to ensure the general safety of people and property, causes danger to the life of people or property of great value, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.
(2)	Whoever with explosives or other dangerous act and means, with the intention of extortion, intimidation, coercion to commit or omit some other act, revenge or obtaining property or non-property benefit for himself or another person, plans, attempts or carries out a dangerous act in which the safety of people or property of greater value is or would be endangered, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(3)	Whoever commits the act from the first paragraph by negligence, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(4)	If the act from the first, second or third paragraph of this Article results in serious bodily injury to one or more persons or major property damage, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first and second paragraphs by imprisonment for up to ten years, and for the act from the third paragraph by imprisonment for up to five years.

(5)	If the act from the first, second or third paragraph of this Article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first paragraph by imprisonment from one to fifteen years, for the act from the second paragraph by imprisonment of at least fifteen years, and for the act from the third paragraph by imprisonment for up to eight years.

Povzročitev nevarnosti pri gradbeni dejavnosti

## 315. člen

(1)	A person who is responsible for planning or supervising plans for the preparation or management of construction or building works, and in doing so acts contrary to regulations or generally recognised technical rules and thereby causes danger to the life of people or property of great value, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	If the act from the preceding paragraph is committed by negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(3)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this Article results in serious bodily injury to one or more persons or major property damage, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first paragraph by imprisonment from one to five years, and for the act from the second paragraph by imprisonment for up to three years.
(4)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this Article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first paragraph by imprisonment from one to twelve years, and for the act from the second paragraph by imprisonment for up to eight years.

## 316. člen (črtan)

Ogrožanje okolja s hrupom ali svetlobo

## 317. člen

(1)	Whoever by violating regulations causes excessive noise or excessively strong lighting with which more serious damage to people's health can be caused, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to two years.
(2)	If the act from the preceding paragraph is committed by negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.

Poškodovanje ali uničenje javnih naprav

## 318. člen

(1)	Whoever destroys, damages or removes electrical lines, gas pipelines, water pipelines, heating pipelines, oil pipelines, telecommunications installations, submarine cables, sewage installations and environmental protection installations or other similar public installations and thereby causes disruptions in the supply to the population or economy, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to five years.

(2)	If the act from the preceding paragraph is committed by negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.

Prevažanje ali prenašanje razstreliva ali nevarnih snovi v nasprotju s predpisi

## 319. člen

Whoever contrary to regulations on traffic in explosives or easily flammable substances or other dangerous substances or dangerous waste transports, hands over for transport by public means of transport such substances or carries them himself when using a public means of transport, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.

Zloraba telekomunikacijskih znamenj

## 320. člen

Whoever knowingly without need sends an internationally agreed sign of call for help or sign that he is in danger, or whoever by a telecommunications sign deceives that safety is given, or whoever otherwise misuses an internationally agreed telecommunications sign, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.

Neodvrnitev nevarnosti

## 321. člen

(1)	Whoever does not report in time to the competent authority or organisation or otherwise does not do everything necessary to avert fire, flood, explosion, traffic accident, ecological accident or any other danger to the life of people or excessive environmental burden or property of greater value, although he could have done so without danger to himself or to another person, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(2)	Whoever by force, threat or deception prevents someone from doing what is necessary to avert danger to the life of people, the environment or property of greater value, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.

Odklonitev sodelovanja pri odvračanju splošne nevarnosti

## 322. člen

Whoever contrary to the order of the competent authority or organisation without justified reason does not participate in averting general danger or eliminating consequences, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to six months.

Enaintrideseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER VARNOST JAVNEGA PROMETA

Povzročitev prometne nesreče iz malomarnosti

heading_path: Opozorilo: Neuradno prečiščeno besedilo predpisa predstavlja zgolj informativni delovni pripomoček, glede katerega organ ne jamči odškodninsko ali kako drugače.
text:
## 323. člen

(1)	Udeleženec v prometu, ki s kršitvijo predpisov o varnosti cestnega prometa iz malomarnosti povzroči prometno nesrečo, v kateri je bila kakšna oseba hudo telesno poškodovana, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Če ima dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do osmih let in s prepovedjo vožnje motornega vozila.
(3)	Storilcu, ki ni imel pravice voziti motornega vozila, s katerim je bilo storjeno kaznivo dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena, se to motorno vozilo vzame. Motorno vozilo, ki je last druge osebe, se vzame, če je ta oseba omogočila, dopustila ali dovolila vožnjo storilcu, za katerega je vedela ali bi bila mogla vedeti, da nima pravice voziti.

Nevarna vožnja v cestnem prometu

## 324. člen

(1)	Voznik motornega vozila, ki v cestnem prometu povzroči neposredno nevarnost za življenje ali telo kakšne osebe s tem, da
1)	vozi pod vplivom alkohola z več kot 1,10 grama alkohola na kilogram krvi ali več kot 0,52 miligrama alkohola v litru izdihanega zraka ali vozi pod vplivom prepovedanih drog, psihoaktivnih zdravil ali drugih psihoaktivnih snovi, ali
2)	prekorači hitrost za več kot 30 km/h od dovoljene na območju za pešce, na območju umirjenega prometa ali na območju omejene hitrosti ali za več kot 50 km/h od dovoljene na cesti, ali
3)	vozi predrzno ali brezobzirno ali vozi motorno vozilo, ki ga nima pravice voziti, in pri tem:
-	ne upošteva pravil o prehitevanju, prednosti ali varnostni razdalji, ali
-	na cesti, ki ima dva ali več označenih pasov za vožnjo v eno smer, vozi po smernem vozišču, namenjenem vožnji v nasprotni smeri, obrača ali vozi vzvratno ali poskuša tako voziti, ali
-	ne prilagodi hitrosti vožnje na nepreglednih odsekih ceste, v križiščih, pred prehodi za pešce ali ob njih, kolesarskih stezah ali prehodih, prehodih ceste čez železniško progo, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Kdor stori dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka iz malomarnosti, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali z zaporom do enega leta.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico prometno nesrečo z lahko telesno poškodbo ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega odstavka z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom od treh mesecev do treh let in s prepovedjo vožnje motornega vozila, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka tega člena pa z denarno kaznijo ali z zaporom do dveh let.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena za posledico prometno nesrečo s hudo telesno poškodbo ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let in s prepovedjo vožnje motornega vozila.
(5)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena za posledico prometno nesrečo s smrtjo ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let in s prepovedjo vožnje motornega vozila.

(6)	Storilcu, ki ni imel pravice voziti motornega vozila, s katerim je bilo storjeno kaznivo dejanje iz prvega, drugega, tretjega, četrtega ali petega odstavka tega člena, se to motorno vozilo vzame. Motorno vozilo, ki je last druge osebe, se vzame, če je ta oseba omogočila, dopustila ali dovolila vožnjo storilcu, za katerega je vedela ali bi bila mogla vedeti, da nima pravice voziti.

Ogrožanje posebnih vrst javnega prometa

## 325. člen

(1)	Kdor s kršitvijo predpisov o varnosti železniškega, ladijskega, zračnega prometa ali prometa na žičnicah ali javnem prevozu potnikov v cestnem prometu s kršitvijo predpisov o varnosti cestnega prometa iz malomarnosti povzroči nesrečo, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Če ima dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo kakšne osebe, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do petih let in s prepovedjo vožnje motornega vozila.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do osmih let in s prepovedjo vožnje motornega vozila.

Ogrožanje javnega prometa z nevarnim dejanjem ali sredstvom

## 326. člen

(1)	Kdor uniči ali poškoduje prometne naprave, prometna sredstva, prometne znake in naprave za signalizacijo, prometne varnostne naprave, daje napačne signale ali znamenja, postavlja ovire na prometnih poteh ali ravna na drug podoben način in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje ljudi ali premoženje velike vrednosti, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Če je dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ene ali več oseb ali veliko premoženjsko škodo, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega odstavka z zaporom do petih let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka pa z zaporom do treh let.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega odstavka z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka pa z zaporom do osmih let.

Opustitev nadzorstva v javnem prometu

## 327. člen

(1)	Oseba, ki ji je zaupano nadzorstvo nad vzdrževanjem cest, mostov, nad prevoznimi sredstvi ali javnim prometom ali vodstvo ali usmerjanje vožnje, pa s kršitvijo svoje

dolžnosti povzroči nevarnost za življenje ljudi ali premoženje velike vrednosti, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje oseba, ki da nalog za vožnjo, čeprav ve, da voznik zaradi utrujenosti ali iz kakšnega drugega vzroka ni zmožen voziti vozila ali da prevozno sredstvo ni brezhibno, in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje ljudi ali premoženje velike vrednosti.
(3)	Če je dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ene ali več oseb ali veliko premoženjsko škodo, se storilec za dejanje iz prvega in drugega odstavka kaznuje z zaporom do petih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka pa z zaporom do treh let.
(5)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec za dejanje iz prvega in drugega odstavka kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka pa z zaporom do osmih let.

Zapustitev poškodovanca v prometni nesreči brez pomoči

## 328. člen

(1)	Voznik motornega vozila ali drugega prevoznega sredstva, ki pusti brez pomoči koga, ki je bil s tem prevoznim sredstvom ali zaradi njega poškodovan, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Če ima opustitev pomoči za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ali smrt poškodovanega, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od treh mesecev do petih let.

Ugrabitev zrakoplova ali plovila

## 329. člen

Kdor s silo ali resno grožnjo, da bo uporabil silo, prevzame nadzor nad zrakoplovom, ki leti, ali nad plovilom, ki pluje, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do petnajstih let.

Napad na varnost zračnega prometa

## 323. člen

(1)	A participant in traffic who, through a breach of road safety regulations by negligence, causes a traffic accident in which a person is seriously injured, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	If the act from the preceding paragraph results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to eight years and by prohibition from driving a motor vehicle.
(3)	The perpetrator who did not have the right to drive the motor vehicle with which the criminal offence from the first or second paragraph of this article was committed shall have that motor vehicle confiscated. A motor vehicle that is the property of another person shall be confiscated if that person enabled, permitted or allowed the perpetrator to drive, knowing or having been able to know that the perpetrator did not have the right to drive.

Dangerous driving in road traffic

## 324. člen

(1)	A driver of a motor vehicle who in road traffic causes direct danger to the life or body of a person by
1)	driving under the influence of alcohol with more than 1.10 grams of alcohol per kilogram of blood or more than 0.52 milligrams of alcohol per litre of exhaled air or driving under the influence of prohibited drugs, psychoactive medicines or other psychoactive substances, or
2)	exceeding the speed limit by more than 30 km/h in a pedestrian zone, in a traffic calming zone or in a speed restriction zone, or by more than 50 km/h on a road, or
3)	driving recklessly or inconsiderately or driving a motor vehicle which he or she does not have the right to drive, and in doing so:
-	fails to observe the rules on overtaking, priority or safe distance, or
-	on a road that has two or more marked lanes for driving in one direction, drives on the carriageway intended for driving in the opposite direction, turns around or drives in reverse or attempts to drive in such a manner, or
-	fails to adjust the driving speed on non-visible sections of road, at intersections, before or at pedestrian crossings, cycle paths or crossings, crossings of the road over a railway line, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	Whoever commits the act from the preceding paragraph by negligence shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.
(3)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article results in a traffic accident with minor bodily injury to one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first paragraph by a fine or imprisonment from three months to three years and by prohibition from driving a motor vehicle, and for the act from the second paragraph of this article by a fine or imprisonment of up to two years.
(4)	If the act from the first paragraph of this article results in a traffic accident with serious bodily injury to one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years and by prohibition from driving a motor vehicle.
(5)	If the act from the first paragraph of this article results in a traffic accident with the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to twelve years and by prohibition from driving a motor vehicle.

(6)	The perpetrator who did not have the right to drive the motor vehicle with which the criminal offence from the first, second, third, fourth or fifth paragraph of this article was committed shall have that motor vehicle confiscated. A motor vehicle that is the property of another person shall be confiscated if that person enabled, permitted or allowed the perpetrator to drive, knowing or having been able to know that the perpetrator did not have the right to drive.

Endangering special types of public transport

## 325. člen

(1)	Whoever, by breaching regulations on the safety of railway, maritime, air transport or transport on cable cars or public passenger transport in road traffic by breaching road safety regulations by negligence, causes an accident, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to two years.
(2)	If the act from the preceding paragraph results in serious bodily injury to a person, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years and by prohibition from driving a motor vehicle.
(3)	If the act from the first paragraph of this article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to eight years and by prohibition from driving a motor vehicle.

Endangering public transport by a dangerous act or means

## 326. člen

(1)	Whoever destroys or damages traffic facilities, means of transport, traffic signs and signalling devices, traffic safety devices, gives false signals or signs, places obstacles on traffic routes or acts in another similar manner and thereby causes danger to human life or property of great value, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	If the act from the preceding paragraph is committed by negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to one year.
(3)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article results in serious bodily injury to one or more persons or great material damage, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first paragraph by imprisonment of up to five years, and for the act from the second paragraph by imprisonment of up to three years.
(4)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first paragraph by imprisonment from one to twelve years, and for the act from the second paragraph by imprisonment of up to eight years.

Omission of supervision in public transport

## 327. člen

(1)	A person entrusted with supervision over the maintenance of roads, bridges, means of transport or public transport or the management or direction of driving, who by breaching their

duty causes danger to human life or property of great value, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	A person who gives an order to drive, although knowing that the driver is unable to drive the vehicle due to fatigue or some other reason or that the means of transport is not in proper condition, and thereby causes danger to human life or property of great value, shall be punished in the same manner.
(3)	If the act from the first or second paragraph of this article is committed by negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to one year.
(4)	If the act from the first, second or third paragraph of this article results in serious bodily injury to one or more persons or great material damage, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first and second paragraph by imprisonment of up to five years, and for the act from the third paragraph by imprisonment of up to three years.
(5)	If the act from the first, second or third paragraph of this article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act from the first and second paragraph by imprisonment from one to twelve years, and for the act from the third paragraph by imprisonment of up to eight years.

Abandonment of an injured person in a traffic accident without assistance

## 328. člen

(1)	A driver of a motor vehicle or other means of transport who leaves without assistance a person who has been injured by that means of transport or because of it, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to one year.
(2)	If the omission of assistance results in serious bodily injury or death of the injured person, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.

Hijacking of an aircraft or vessel

## 329. člen

Whoever by force or serious threat to use force takes control of an aircraft in flight or a vessel under way, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to fifteen years.

## 330. člen

(1)	Kdor spravi v nevarnost let zrakoplova, tako da položi ali prinese v zrakoplov razstrelivo ali druge podobne naprave ali snovi, uniči ali poškoduje navigacijske naprave na zrakoplovu ali napravi na njem kakšno drugo škodo ali daje napačna obvestila v zvezi z letom ali z napadom na posadko civilnega zrakoplova omejuje ali zmanjšuje sposobnost opravljanja dolžnosti članov posadke, ali s kršitvijo varnostnih navodil, ki so vidno označena ali jih potnikom posreduje vodja zrakoplova ali ostali člani posadke, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.

(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor ogrozi varnost na letališču tako, da s silo ali grožnjo z uporabo sile prisili osebje letališča, da prekine poslovanje v zvezi s poleti zrakoplovov, ali z razstrelivom ali drugo podobno napravo ali snovjo uniči ali poškoduje zrakoplov ali naprave, namenjene za varnost zračnega prometa.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb ali uničenje zrakoplova ali letališča, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od treh do petnajstih let.

Uničenje in odstranitev znamenj, namenjenih za varnost zračnega prometa

## 331. člen

Kdor uniči, poškoduje ali odstrani znamenje, ki je namenjeno za varnost zračnega prometa, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.

Obremenjevanje in uničevanje okolja

## 332. člen

(1)	Kdor s kršitvijo predpisov:
1)	z izpusti, emisijami ali vnosi količin snovi ali ionizirajočega sevanja v zrak, zemljo ali vodo spravi v nevarnost življenje ene ali več oseb ali povzroči nevarnost nastanka hude telesne poškodbe ali dejanske škode kakovosti zraka, zemlje ali vode ali živalim ali rastlinam;
2)	zbira, prevaža, predeluje ali odstranjuje odpadke ali opravlja nadzor nad takimi postopki ali dejavnostmi po prenehanju obratovanja naprave za odstranjevanje odpadkov, ali trguje z odpadki ali jih posreduje tako, da spravi v nevarnost življenje ene ali več oseb ali povzroči nevarnost nastanka hude telesne poškodbe ali dejanske škode kakovosti zraka, zemlje ali vode ali živalim ali rastlinam;
3)	iz 35. točke 2. člena Uredbe (ES) Evropskega parlamenta in Sveta z dne 14. junija 2006 o pošiljkah odpadkov, pošilja nezanemarljive količine odpadkov v eni pošiljki ali v več pošiljkah, ki se zdijo povezane;
4)	upravlja obrat, v katerem se opravlja nevarna dejavnost ali se v njem skladiščijo nevarne snovi ali pripravki, kar bi zunaj obrata lahko povzročilo smrt ene ali več oseb ali hudo telesno poškodbo ali dejansko škodo kakovosti zraka, zemlje ali vode ali živalim ali rastlinam;
5)	povzroči nevarnost bistvenega poslabšanja habitata znotraj zaščitenega območja;
6)	proizvaja, uvaža, izvaža, daje na trg ali uporablja snovi, ki tanjšajo ozonski plašč, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Če ima dejanje iz točke 1), 2), 4) ali 5) prejšnjega odstavka za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ali dejansko škodo kakovosti zraka, zemlje ali vode ali živalim ali rastlinam, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do osmih let.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz točke 1), 2) ali 4) prvega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let.

(4)	Če je dejanje storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec za dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka tega člena z zaporom do treh let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka tega člena pa z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(5)	Če je dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena storjeno v hudodelski družbi za izvedbo teh dejanj, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let.

Onesnaženje morja in voda s plovil

## 333. člen

(1)	Kdor s kršitvijo predpisov s plovil izpusti ali odredi izpustitev nafte, kemikalij ali drugih onesnaževal v morje, jezerske ali rečne vode in s tem onesnaži morje, vode ali obale, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor onesnažuje s ponavljajočimi se izpusti manjšega obsega, ki v posameznem primeru ne povzročijo poslabšanja kakovosti morja, jezerske ali rečne vode, v primeru, da gre za ponavljajoče izpuste, pa tako poslabšanje povzročijo.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico poslabšanje zdravja ljudi ali nepopravljivo poškodbo ali uničenje voda ali obale, živalskega ali rastlinskega sveta, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od treh do dvanajstih let.
(5)	Če je dejanje storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec za dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena kaznuje z zaporom do treh let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka tega člena z zaporom od šestih mesecev do petih let, za dejanje iz četrtega odstavka tega člena pa z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(6)	Če je dejanje iz prvega, drugega, tretjega ali četrtega odstavka tega člena storjeno v hudodelski družbi za izvedbo teh dejanj, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let.

Protipravno ravnanje z jedrskimi ali drugimi nevarnimi radioaktivnimi snovmi

## 334. člen

(1)	Kdor v nasprotju s predpisi ali s tehničnimi pravili o varnostnih ukrepih sprejema, poseduje, uporablja, prenaša, spreminja, odlaga, zavrže, omogoča pridobitev, razširja, proizvaja, obdeluje, skladišči, prevaža, uvaža, izvaža ali odstranjuje jedrske snovi ali druge nevarne radioaktivne snovi, kar bi lahko povzročilo smrt ali hudo telesno poškodbo ali veliko premoženjsko škodo ali veliko dejansko škodo na okolju, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Če ima dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ali veliko premoženjsko škodo ali veliko dejansko škodo na okolju, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do osmih let.

(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let.
(4)	Kdor pridobi jedrske snovi s tatvino, ropom, zatajitvijo, poneverbo, goljufijo, zlorabo položaja ali pooblastila, grožnjo ali uporabo sile ali drugim načinom ustrahovanja, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(5)	Kdor z dejanjem, ki je usmerjeno proti jedrskemu objektu, ali dejanjem, ki posega v delovanje jedrskega objekta, povzroči zaradi izpostavljenosti sevanju ali sproščanju radioaktivnih snovi hudo telesno poškodbo ali smrt ene ali več oseb, veliko premoženjsko škodo ali veliko dejansko škodo na okolju ali kdor povzroči nevarnost nastanka katere od navedenih posledic, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do petnajstih let.
(6)	Kdor grozi, da bo jedrske snovi uporabil tako, da bo povzročil hudo telesno poškodbo ali smrt ene ali več oseb, veliko premoženjsko škodo ali veliko dejansko škodo na okolju ali da bo storil dejanje iz četrtega ali petega odstavka tega člena zato, da bo katera koli fizična ali pravna oseba prisiljena, da stori ali opusti katero koli dejanje, se kaznuje z zaporom do petnajstih let.
(7)	Če je dejanje storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec za dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena kaznuje z zaporom do treh let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka tega člena z zaporom od šestih mesecev do petih let, za dejanje iz tretjega odstavka tega člena pa z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(8)	Če je bilo dejanje iz prvega, drugega, tretjega, četrtega, petega ali šestega odstavka tega člena storjeno v hudodelski združbi za izvedbo teh dejanj, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do petnajstih let.

## 330. člen

(1)	Whoever endangers the flight of an aircraft by placing or bringing explosives or other similar devices or substances into the aircraft, destroys or damages navigation devices on the aircraft or causes any other damage to it, or gives false information in connection with the flight, or by attacking the crew of a civil aircraft restricts or reduces the ability of crew members to perform their duties, or by violating safety instructions that are visibly marked or communicated to passengers by the commander of the aircraft or other crew members, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.

(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever endangers safety at an airport by using force or threatening to use force to compel airport personnel to interrupt operations in connection with aircraft flights, or by using explosives or other similar devices or substances to destroy or damage an aircraft or facilities intended for the safety of air traffic.
(3)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Article results in the death of one or more persons or the destruction of an aircraft or airport, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.

Destruction and removal of signs intended for the safety of air traffic

## 331. člen

Whoever destroys, damages or removes a sign intended for the safety of air traffic shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.

Thirty-second chapter
CRIMINAL OFFENCES AGAINST THE ENVIRONMENT, SPACE AND NATURAL RESOURCES

Pollution and destruction of the environment

## 332. člen

(1)	Whoever, in violation of regulations:
1)	by discharges, emissions or inputs of quantities of substances or ionising radiation into the air, soil or water, endangers the life of one or more persons or causes a risk of serious bodily injury or actual damage to the quality of air, soil or water or to animals or plants;
2)	collects, transports, processes or disposes of waste or supervises such procedures or activities after the cessation of operation of a waste disposal facility, or trades in waste or brokers it in such a way as to endanger the life of one or more persons or cause a risk of serious bodily injury or actual damage to the quality of air, soil or water or to animals or plants;
3)	within the meaning of point 35 of Article 2 of Regulation (EC) of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 June 2006 on shipments of waste, ships non-negligible quantities of waste in one shipment or in several shipments that appear to be linked;
4)	operates a plant in which a hazardous activity is carried out or in which hazardous substances or preparations are stored, which could cause the death of one or more persons or serious bodily injury or actual damage to the quality of air, soil or water or to animals or plants outside the plant;
5)	causes a risk of significant deterioration of a habitat within a protected area;
6)	produces, imports, exports, places on the market or uses substances that deplete the ozone layer, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(2)	If the act referred to in point 1), 2), 4) or 5) of the preceding paragraph results in serious bodily injury or actual damage to the quality of air, soil or water or to animals or plants, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of up to eight years.
(3)	If the act referred to in point 1), 2) or 4) of the first paragraph of this Article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to twelve years.

(4)	If the act is committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first paragraph of this Article by a fine or imprisonment of up to two years, for the act referred to in the second paragraph of this Article by imprisonment of up to three years, and for the act referred to in the third paragraph of this Article by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(5)	If the act referred to in the first, second or third paragraph of this Article is committed within a criminal organisation for the commission of these acts, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to twelve years.

Pollution of the sea and waters from vessels

## 333. člen

(1)	Whoever, in violation of regulations, discharges or orders the discharge of oil, chemicals or other pollutants from vessels into the sea, lake or river waters and thereby pollutes the sea, waters or coasts, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever pollutes through repeated discharges of a smaller scale which in individual cases do not cause deterioration of the quality of the sea, lake or river water, but in the case of repeated discharges cause such deterioration.
(3)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Article results in deterioration of human health or irreparable damage to or destruction of waters or coasts, animal or plant life, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(4)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three to twelve years.
(5)	If the act is committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Article by imprisonment of up to three years, for the act referred to in the third paragraph of this Article by imprisonment from six months to five years, and for the act referred to in the fourth paragraph of this Article by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(6)	If the act referred to in the first, second, third or fourth paragraph of this Article is committed within a criminal organisation for the commission of these acts, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to twelve years.

Unlawful handling of nuclear or other dangerous radioactive substances

## 334. člen

(1)	Whoever, contrary to regulations or technical rules on safety measures, receives, possesses, uses, transfers, alters, disposes of, discards, enables the acquisition of, distributes, produces, processes, stores, transports, imports, exports or removes nuclear substances or other dangerous radioactive substances, which could cause death or serious bodily injury or great property damage or great actual damage to the environment, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(2)	If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph results in serious bodily injury or great property damage or great actual damage to the environment, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to eight years.

(3)	If the act referred to in the first paragraph of this Article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to twelve years.
(4)	Whoever obtains nuclear substances by theft, robbery, misappropriation, embezzlement, fraud, abuse of position or authority, threat or use of force or other means of intimidation, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(5)	Whoever, by an act directed against a nuclear facility or by an act interfering with the operation of a nuclear facility, causes serious bodily injury or death of one or more persons, great property damage or great actual damage to the environment due to exposure to radiation or release of radioactive substances, or whoever causes a risk of any of the stated consequences, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to fifteen years.
(6)	Whoever threatens to use nuclear substances in such a way as to cause serious bodily injury or death of one or more persons, great property damage or great actual damage to the environment, or to commit an act referred to in the fourth or fifth paragraph of this Article in order to compel any natural or legal person to do or omit any act, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to fifteen years.
(7)	If the act is committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first paragraph of this Article by imprisonment of up to three years, for the act referred to in the second paragraph of this Article by imprisonment from six months to five years, and for the act referred to in the third paragraph of this Article by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(8)	If the act referred to in the first, second, third, fourth, fifth or sixth paragraph of this Article was committed within a criminal association for the commission of these acts, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to fifteen years.

## 335. člen (deleted)

Pollution of drinking water

## 336. člen

(1)	Kdor s kakšno škodljivo snovjo onesnaži vodo, ki jo ljudje uporabljajo kot pitno vodo in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje ali zdravje ljudi, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Če je dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do treh mesecev.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega odstavka z zaporom do petih let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka pa z zaporom do treh let.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega odstavka z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka pa z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(5)	Kdor s kakšno škodljivo snovjo onesnaži vodo, ki je namenjena za napajanje živali in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje in zdravje živali, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

(6)	Če ima dejanje iz petega odstavka za posledico pogin živali večje vrednosti ali večjega števila živali, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Onesnaženje živil ali krme

## 337. člen

(1)	Kdor s kakšno škodljivo snovjo onesnaži živila in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje ali zdravje ljudi, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Če je dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do treh mesecev.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico hudo telesno poškodbo ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega odstavka z zaporom do petih let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka pa z zaporom do treh let.
(4)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, se storilec kaznuje za dejanje iz prvega odstavka z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let, za dejanje iz drugega odstavka pa z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(5)	Kdor s kakšno škodljivo snovjo onesnaži živalsko krmo ali druga krmila, ki so namenjena za prehrano živali in tako povzroči nevarnost za življenje ali zdravje živali, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(6)	Če ima dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka za posledico pogin živali večje vrednosti ali večjega števila živali, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Protipravno zavzetje nepremičnine

## 338. člen

(1)	Kdor zavzame tuje zemljišče, ki je po predpisih določeno za zavarovano zemljišče ali območje, naravno vrednoto ali javno dobro, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor zavzame tuje zemljišče z namenom, da ga uporabi za
gradnjo.

Uničenje nasadov s škodljivo snovjo

## 339. člen

Kdor s škodljivo snovjo povzroči uničenje tujih rastlin, sadnih dreves ali drugih nasadov in s tem povzroči večjo škodo na teh nasadih, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.

Uničevanje gozdov

## 340. člen

(1)	Kdor zavestno v nasprotju s predpisi ali odredbami pristojnih organov v večjem obsegu krči ali seka na golo gozd ali ga kako drugače uničuje, pa pri tem niso dani znaki kakšnega drugega kaznivega dejanja, se kaznuje z zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Kdor stori dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka v varovalnem gozdu ali gozdu, ki ima poseben namen, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Mučenje živali

## 341. člen

(1)	Kdor surovo ravna z živaljo ali ji po nepotrebnem povzroča trpljenje, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Kdor se ukvarja z organizacijo borb živali ali stav v zvezi z borbo živali ali se ukvarja z vzrejo in vzgojo živali z namenom uporabe za borbo živali, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let in denarno kaznijo.
(3)	Kdor z dejanjem iz prvega odstavka tega člena muči več živali ali mučeno žival trajno pohabi ali na krut način povzroči njen pogin, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(4)	Če je zaradi dejanja iz drugega odstavka tega člena žival trajno hudo pohabljena ali pogine, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do treh let in denarno kaznijo.

Nezakonit lov

## 342. člen

(1)	Kdor brez dovoljenja ali sicer neupravičeno lovi in ubije ali rani divjo žival ali jo ujame živo, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do šestih mesecev.
(2)	Če gre pri dejanju iz prejšnjega odstavka za divjad večje vrednosti ali divjad, pomembno po predpisih o lovstvu, ali je dejanje storjeno med varstveno dobo ali v skupini, se storilec kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(3)	Kdor lovi ogrožene ali zredčene vrste divjadi, katerih lov je prepovedan, kdor lovi brez posebnega dovoljenja divjad posamezne vrste, za katero je potrebno tako dovoljenje, kdor lovi na način ali s sredstvi, s katerimi se divjad množično pokončuje ali kdor lovi s pomočjo motornega vozila ali žarometa, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do dveh let.

Nezakoniti ribolov

## 343. člen

Kdor lovi ribe z razstrelivom, elektriko, strupom, omamnim sredstvom, pa pri tem povzroči pogin rib, ali lovi na način, ki je škodljiv za njihovo razmnoževanje, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

Nezakonito ravnanje z zavarovanimi prostoživečimi živalskimi in rastlinskimi vrstami

## 344. člen

(1)	Kdor nezakonito poseduje, odvzame, poškoduje, usmrti, izvaža, uvaža, iznaša, vnaša ali trguje z zavarovanimi prostoživečimi živalskimi in rastlinskimi vrstami ali njihovimi deli ali iz njih izdelanimi izdelki, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Če je stvar iz prejšnjega odstavka velikega ali izjemnega naravovarstvenega pomena ali če je dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka storjeno v hudodelski združbi za izvedbo takih dejanj, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do petih let.

Prenašanje kužnih bolezni pri živalih in rastlinah

## 345. člen

(1)	Kdor med epidemijo kakšne živalske kužne bolezni, ki lahko spravi v nevarnost rejo živali na celotnem območju države, ne ravna po predpisih, s katerimi so določeni ukrepi za zatiranje ali preprečevanje bolezni, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor med trajanjem nevarnosti za bolezen ali škodljivce, ki lahko spravijo v nevarnost rastlinski svet na celotnem območju države, ne ravna po predpisih, s katerimi so določeni ukrepi za zatiranje ali preprečevanje bolezni ali škodljivcev.
(3)	Če ima dejanje iz prvega ali drugega odstavka tega člena za posledico razširitev kužne bolezni ali škodljivcev v večjem obsegu, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(4)	Če je dejanje iz prvega, drugega ali tretjega odstavka tega člena storjeno iz malomarnosti, se storilec kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do šestih mesecev.

Izdelovanje škodljivih zdravil za zdravljenje živali

## 346. člen

(1)	Kdor izdela za prodajo ali razpečava snovi kot zdravila za zdravljenje ali preprečevanje kužnih bolezni pri živalih, ki so nevarna za njihovo življenje ali zdravje, pa so zaradi tega poginile živali večje vrednosti ali več živali ali so se razširile kužne bolezni, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Snovi iz prejšnjega odstavka tega člena se vzamejo.

Nevestna veterinarska pomoč

## 347. člen

Veterinar ali drug veterinarski delavec, ki pri opravljanju veterinarske dejavnosti iz malomarnosti ravna v očitnem nasprotju s pravili veterinarske znanosti in stroke in tako

povzroči pogin živali večje vrednosti, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.

Triintrideseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER SUVERENOST REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE IN NJENO DEMOKRATIČNO USTAVNO UREDITEV

Veleizdaja

## 348. člen

Kdor s silo ali grožnjo, da bo uporabil silo, ogrozi obstoj Republike Slovenije ali tako poskuša spremeniti njeno ustavno ureditev ali strmoglaviti najvišje državne organe, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.

Napad na ozemeljsko celovitost
translated_text:
## 336. člen

(1)	Whoever contaminates water used by people as drinking water with any harmful substance and thereby causes danger to the life or health of people shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph is committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to three months.
(3)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this article results in serious bodily injury to one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first paragraph by imprisonment for up to five years, and for the act referred to in the second paragraph by imprisonment for up to three years.
(4)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first paragraph by imprisonment from one to twelve years, and for the act referred to in the second paragraph by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(5)	Whoever contaminates water intended for watering animals with any harmful substance and thereby causes danger to the life and health of animals shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.

(6)	If the act referred to in the fifth paragraph results in the death of animals of greater value or a greater number of animals, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.

Contamination of foodstuffs or feed

## 337. člen

(1)	Whoever contaminates foodstuffs with any harmful substance and thereby causes danger to the life or health of people shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph is committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to three months.
(3)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this article results in serious bodily injury to one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first paragraph by imprisonment for up to five years, and for the act referred to in the second paragraph by imprisonment for up to three years.
(4)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this article results in the death of one or more persons, the perpetrator shall be punished for the act referred to in the first paragraph by imprisonment from one to twelve years, and for the act referred to in the second paragraph by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(5)	Whoever contaminates animal feed or other feedstuffs intended for the nutrition of animals with any harmful substance and thereby causes danger to the life or health of animals shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(6)	If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph results in the death of animals of greater value or a greater number of animals, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.

Unlawful occupation of immovable property

## 338. člen

(1)	Whoever occupies another's land which is designated by regulations as protected land or area, natural monument or public good shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever occupies another's land with the intention of using it for construction.

Destruction of plantations with harmful substances

## 339. člen

Whoever causes the destruction of another's plants, fruit trees or other plantations with a harmful substance and thereby causes greater damage to these plantations shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to two years.

Destruction of forests

## 340. člen

(1)	Whoever deliberately, in contravention of regulations or orders of competent authorities, clears or clear-cuts forest on a large scale or otherwise destroys it, where the elements of any other criminal offence are not present, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.
(2)	Whoever commits the act referred to in the preceding paragraph in a protective forest or a forest with a special purpose shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.

Cruelty to animals

## 341. člen

(1)	Whoever treats an animal cruelly or unnecessarily causes it suffering shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(2)	Whoever engages in organising animal fights or betting in connection with animal fights or engages in breeding and raising animals for the purpose of use in animal fights shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years and a fine.
(3)	Whoever, by the act referred to in the first paragraph of this article, tortures several animals or permanently mutilates a tortured animal or causes its death in a cruel manner shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(4)	If, as a result of the act referred to in the second paragraph of this article, an animal is permanently seriously mutilated or dies, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years and a fine.

Illegal hunting

## 342. člen

(1)	Whoever, without permission or otherwise unlawfully, hunts and kills or injures a wild animal or captures it alive shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to six months.
(2)	If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph concerns game of greater value or game significant under hunting regulations, or if the act is committed during the protection period or in a group, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(3)	Whoever hunts endangered or rare species of game whose hunting is prohibited, whoever hunts without special permission game of a particular species for which such permission is required, whoever hunts in a manner or with means by which game is killed en masse, or whoever hunts with the aid of a motor vehicle or searchlight shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to two years.

Illegal fishing

## 343. člen

Whoever catches fish with explosives, electricity, poison, narcotic substances and thereby causes the death of fish, or fishes in a manner harmful to their reproduction, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.

Illegal handling of protected wild animal and plant species

## 344. člen

(1)	Whoever unlawfully possesses, takes, damages, kills, exports, imports, takes out, brings in or trades in protected wild animal and plant species or their parts or products made from them shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2)	If the object referred to in the preceding paragraph is of great or exceptional nature conservation importance, or if the act referred to in the preceding paragraph is committed in a criminal organisation for the commission of such acts, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.

Transmission of contagious diseases in animals and plants

## 345. člen

(1)	Whoever, during an epidemic of any animal contagious disease that may endanger animal husbandry throughout the territory of the state, does not act in accordance with regulations prescribing measures for suppressing or preventing the disease shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever, during the existence of danger from a disease or pests that may endanger the plant world throughout the territory of the state, does not act in accordance with regulations prescribing measures for suppressing or preventing the disease or pests.
(3)	If the act referred to in the first or second paragraph of this article results in the spread of a contagious disease or pests on a large scale, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.
(4)	If the act referred to in the first, second or third paragraph of this article is committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to six months.

Production of harmful medicines for the treatment of animals

## 346. člen

(1)	Whoever produces for sale or distributes substances as medicines for the treatment or prevention of contagious diseases in animals that are dangerous to their life or health, and as a result animals of greater value or several animals have died or contagious diseases have spread, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(2)	The substances referred to in the preceding paragraph of this article shall be seized.

Negligent veterinary assistance

## 347. člen

A veterinarian or other veterinary worker who, in performing veterinary activities, acts through negligence in obvious contravention of the rules of veterinary science and profession and thereby causes the death of animals of greater value shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.

CRIMINAL OFFENCES AGAINST THE SOVEREIGNTY OF THE REPUBLIC OF SLOVENIA AND ITS DEMOCRATIC CONSTITUTIONAL ORDER

High treason

## 348. člen

Whoever, by force or threat to use force, endangers the existence of the Republic of Slovenia or thus attempts to change its constitutional order or overthrow the highest state authorities shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.

Attack on territorial integrity

## 349. člen

Kdor poskuša s silo ali grožnjo, da bo uporabil silo, odcepiti del ozemlja Republike Slovenije ali del tega ozemlja pripojiti drugi državi, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.

Napad na neodvisnost države

## 350. člen

Državljan Republike Slovenije, ki poskuša spraviti Republiko Slovenijo v podrejenost ali odvisnost nasproti drugi državi, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.

Kršitev ozemeljske nedotakljivosti

## 351. člen

Kdor vdre na ozemlje Republike Slovenije zaradi kršitve njene ozemeljske nedotakljivosti, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.

Uboj predsednika republike

## 352. člen

Kdor, zato da bi ogrozil ustavno ureditev ali varnost Republike Slovenije, vzame življenje predsednika Republike Slovenije ali tistega, ki ga nadomešča, se kaznuje z zaporom najmanj petnajstih let.

Nasilje zoper najvišje predstavnike države

## 353. člen

Kdor, zato da bi ogrozil opravljanje nalog v demokratični ureditvi ali varnost Republike Slovenije, ugrabi koga od najvišjih predstavnikov države, poslanca, člana državnega sveta, člana vlade, sodnika ustavnega ali vrhovnega sodišča ali stori zoper njega ali njegovega bližnjega kakšno drugo nasilje ali napade njegove uradne prostore, zasebno stanovanje ali prevozno sredstvo, se kaznuje z zaporom najmanj petnajstih let.

Nasilje zoper predstavnike tujih držav ali mednarodnih organizacij

## 354. člen

Kdor, zato da bi ogrozil ustavno ureditev ali varnost Republike Slovenije ali škodoval tuji državi, ugrabi predstavnika tuje države ali mednarodne organizacije ali stori zoper njega ali njegovega bližnjega kakšno drugo nasilje ali napade njegove uradne prostore, zasebno stanovanje ali prevozno sredstvo, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh do petnajstih let.

Oborožen upor

## 355. člen

(1)	Kdor organizira ali vodi oborožen upor, da bi ogrozil obstoj Republike Slovenije, spremenil njeno ustavno ureditev ali strmoglavil njene najvišje državne organe, se kaznuje z zaporom najmanj petnajstih let.
(2)	Kdor sodeluje v oboroženem uporu iz prejšnjega odstavka, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.

Diverzija

## 356. člen

Kdor, zato da bi ogrozil ustavno ureditev ali varnost Republike Slovenije, poruši, zažge ali kako drugače uniči ali poškoduje kakšen gospodarski objekt, prometno sredstvo ali prometno napravo, napravo, namenjeno sistemu zvez, javno napravo za vodo ali prenos energije ali kakšen drug objekt, pomemben za varnost ljudi, preskrbo prebivalstva ali gospodarstvo, se kaznuje z zaporom najmanj petnajstih let.

Sabotaža

## 357. člen

(1)	Kdor, zato da bi ogrozil ustavno ureditev ali varnost Republike Slovenije, prikrito, zahrbtno ali na drug podoben način povzroči pri opravljanju svoje delovne obveznosti

veliko škodo državnemu organu ali organizaciji, v kateri dela, ali drugemu državnemu organu ali organizaciji, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do desetih let.
(2)	Če je dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka storjeno na jedrskem objektu, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od enega do dvanajstih let.

Vohunstvo

## 358. člen

(1)	Kdor služi tuji državi ali tuji organizaciji ali njunemu agentu, tako da zbira zaupne vojaške, gospodarske ali uradne podatke ali dokumente ali ji jih sporoči ali izroči ali ji omogoči, da pride do njih, se kaznuje z zaporom od enega do osmih let.
(2)	Kdor v škodo Republike Slovenije ustvari za tujo državo ali tujo organizacijo obveščevalno službo ali jo vodi, se kaznuje z zaporom od treh do petnajstih let.
(3)	Kdor se vključi v tujo obveščevalno službo iz prejšnjega odstavka ali podpira njeno delo, se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do petih let.

Ščuvanje k nasilni spremembi ustavne ureditve

## 359. člen

(1)	Kdor, zato da bi ogrozil obstoj, ustavno ureditev ali varnost Republike Slovenije, poziva ali ščuva k neposredni storitvi kaznivih dejanj iz 348. do 357. člena tega zakonika, se kaznuje z zaporom do petih let.
(2)	Kdor stori dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka z premoženjsko ali kako drugo pomočjo iz tujine, se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do petih let.
(3)	Kdor izdeluje ali razmnožuje gradivo, s katerim se poziva ali ščuva k storitvi kaznivih dejanj iz prvega odstavka tega člena, zato da bi ga sam ali kdo drug razširjal, ali kdor z enakim namenom hrani večjo količino takega gradiva ali ga razširja, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.

Kaznovanje za najhujše oblike kaznivih dejanj

## 360. člen

(1)	Za kaznivo dejanje iz 348. do 351. člena ter 354. in 357. člena tega zakonika, ki ima za posledico smrt ene ali več oseb, hudo nasilje ali veliko razdejanje, se storilec kaznuje z zaporom od desetih do petnajstih let.
(2)	Če storilec pri storitvi dejanj iz prejšnjega odstavka naklepoma vzame življenje eni ali več osebam, se kaznuje z zaporom najmanj petnajstih let.

Štiriintrideseto poglavje
KAZNIVA DEJANJA ZOPER OBRAMBNO MOČ DRŽAVE

Izmikanje obrambnim dolžnostim

## 361. člen

(1)	Kdor se, ko je razglašeno izredno ali vojno stanje, skriva ali se ne odzove na poziv za izpolnitev obrambne dolžnosti, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do enega leta.
(2)	Kdor, zato da bi se v času razglašenega izrednega ali vojnega stanja izognil obrambni dolžnosti kot nezmožen za tako dolžnost, hlini bolezen, uporabi ponarejeno listino ali kako drugače preslepi pristojni organ, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(3)	Enako kot v prejšnjem odstavku se kaznuje, kdor stori dejanje iz prejšnjega odstavka, s tem da se sam ali s pomočjo drugega poškoduje ali kako drugače napravi za nezmožnega za obrambno dolžnost.

Izmikanje obrambnim dolžnostim s preslepitvijo

## 362. člen

(1)	Kdor, ko je razglašeno izredno ali vojno stanje, hlini bolezen, uporabi ponarejeno listino ali kako drugače preslepi pristojni organ, da bi se izognil vojaški službi ali drugi obrambni dolžnosti, in ga tako zapelje, da ga ta razglasi za nezmožnega za opravljanje vojaške službe ali vojaške dolžnosti, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(2)	Enako se kaznuje, kdor, da bi se izognil službi ali obveznosti iz prejšnjega odstavka ali da bi bil določen za lažjo službo ali obveznost, samega sebe poškoduje ali kako drugače napravi nezmožnega ali dovoli drugemu, da ga napravi nezmožnega.
(3)	Kdor drugega z njegovim dovoljenjem ali brez njegovega dovoljenja telesno poškoduje ali ga kako drugače napravi nezmožnega, da bi se izognil vojaški službi ali drugi vojaški obveznosti, se kaznuje z zaporom od šestih mesecev do petih let.

Sila proti vojaški osebi pri opravljanju vojaške dolžnosti

## 363. člen

(1)	Kdor s silo ali grožnjo, da bo neposredno uporabil silo, prepreči vojaški osebi opravljati vojaško dolžnost ali jo na enak način prisili opravljati vojaško dolžnost, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Poskus je kazniv.
(3)	Če storilec ob storitvi dejanja iz prvega odstavka tega člena razžali vojaško osebo, grdo ravna z njo ali ji prizadene lahko telesno poškodbo ali ji grozi z uporabo orožja, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(4)	Če je bil storilec dejanja iz prvega do tretjega odstavka tega člena izzvan z nezakonitim ali surovim ravnanjem vojaške osebe, se kaznuje z denarno kaznijo ali zaporom do šestih mesecev, sme pa se mu tudi odpustiti kazen.

Napad na vojaško osebo, ki opravlja službo

## 364. člen

(1)	Kdor napade ali resno zagrozi, da bo napadel vojaško osebo, ki opravlja službo, se kaznuje z zaporom do dveh let.
(2)	Če storilec pri dejanju iz prejšnjega odstavka vojaški osebi grozi z orožjem, z njo grdo ravna ali jo lahko telesno poškoduje, se kaznuje z zaporom do treh let.
(3)	S kaznijo iz prejšnjega odstavka se kaznuje, kdor stori dejanje iz prvega odstavka tega člena proti dvema ali več vojaškim osebam.

Nevestno ravnanje s sredstvi za obrambo
translated_text:
## 349. člen

Whoever attempts by force or threat to use force to secede part of the territory of the Republic of Slovenia or to annex part of that territory to another state shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.

Attack on the independence of the state

## 350. člen

A citizen of the Republic of Slovenia who attempts to bring the Republic of Slovenia into subordination or dependence in relation to another state shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.

Violation of territorial integrity

## 351. člen

Whoever invades the territory of the Republic of Slovenia in order to violate its territorial integrity shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.

Murder of the president of the republic

## 352. člen

Whoever, in order to endanger the constitutional order or security of the Republic of Slovenia, takes the life of the President of the Republic of Slovenia or of the person replacing him shall be punished by imprisonment of at least fifteen years.

Violence against the highest representatives of the state

## 353. člen

Whoever, in order to endanger the performance of duties in a democratic order or the security of the Republic of Slovenia, abducts any of the highest representatives of the state, a member of parliament, a member of the National Council, a member of the government, a judge of the Constitutional Court or the Supreme Court, or commits any other violence against him or his close relative, or attacks his official premises, private residence or means of transport, shall be punished by imprisonment of at least fifteen years.

Violence against representatives of foreign states or international organisations

## 354. člen

Whoever, in order to endanger the constitutional order or security of the Republic of Slovenia or to harm a foreign state, abducts a representative of a foreign state or international organisation, or commits any other violence against him or his close relative, or attacks his official premises, private residence or means of transport, shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.

Armed rebellion

## 355. člen

(1)	Whoever organises or leads an armed rebellion in order to endanger the existence of the Republic of Slovenia, change its constitutional order or overthrow its highest state bodies shall be punished by imprisonment of at least fifteen years.
(2)	Whoever participates in an armed rebellion referred to in the preceding paragraph shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.

Sabotage

## 356. člen

Whoever, in order to endanger the constitutional order or security of the Republic of Slovenia, demolishes, sets fire to or otherwise destroys or damages any economic facility, means of transport or transport installation, installation intended for a communications system, public installation for water or energy transmission or any other facility important for the safety of people, supply of the population or the economy, shall be punished by imprisonment of at least fifteen years.

Sabotage

## 357. člen

(1)	Whoever, in order to endanger the constitutional order or security of the Republic of Slovenia, covertly, treacherously or in another similar manner causes, in the performance of his work obligation,

great damage to a state body or organisation in which he works, or to another state body or organisation, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(2)	If the act referred to in the preceding paragraph is committed at a nuclear facility, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to twelve years.

Espionage

## 358. člen

(1)	Whoever serves a foreign state or foreign organisation or its agent by collecting confidential military, economic or official data or documents, or communicates or hands them over to it, or enables it to obtain them, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(2)	Whoever, to the detriment of the Republic of Slovenia, creates an intelligence service for a foreign state or foreign organisation or leads it shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.
(3)	Whoever joins a foreign intelligence service referred to in the preceding paragraph or supports its work shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.

Incitement to violent change of the constitutional order

## 359. člen

(1)	Whoever, in order to endanger the existence, constitutional order or security of the Republic of Slovenia, calls for or incites the direct commission of criminal offences referred to in Articles 348 to 357 of this Code shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years.
(2)	Whoever commits the act referred to in the preceding paragraph with financial or other assistance from abroad shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(3)	Whoever produces or reproduces material calling for or inciting the commission of criminal offences referred to in the first paragraph of this Article, in order to disseminate it himself or for another to disseminate it, or whoever, with the same intention, stores a large quantity of such material or disseminates it, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.

Punishment for the most serious forms of criminal offences

## 360. člen

(1)	For a criminal offence referred to in Articles 348 to 351 and 354 and 357 of this Code which results in the death of one or more persons, serious violence or great devastation, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from ten to fifteen years.
(2)	If the perpetrator, in committing the acts referred to in the preceding paragraph, intentionally takes the life of one or more persons, he shall be punished by imprisonment of at least fifteen years.

Chapter Thirty-Four
CRIMINAL OFFENCES AGAINST THE DEFENCE POWER OF THE STATE

Evasion of defence duties

## 361. člen

(1)	Whoever, when a state of emergency or war is declared, hides or does not respond to a call to fulfil a defence duty shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to one year.
(2)	Whoever, in order to evade a defence duty during a declared state of emergency or war as incapable of such duty, feigns illness, uses a forged document or otherwise deceives the competent authority, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(3)	The same punishment as in the preceding paragraph shall apply to whoever commits the act referred to in the preceding paragraph by injuring himself or otherwise rendering himself incapable of defence duty, either by himself or with the help of another.

Evasion of defence duties by deception

## 362. člen

(1)	Whoever, when a state of emergency or war is declared, feigns illness, uses a forged document or otherwise deceives the competent authority in order to evade military service or other defence duty, and thereby induces it to declare him incapable of performing military service or military duty, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(2)	The same punishment shall apply to whoever, in order to evade the service or obligation referred to in the preceding paragraph or to be assigned to lighter service or obligation, injures himself or otherwise renders himself incapable, or allows another to render him incapable.
(3)	Whoever physically injures another with or without his consent or otherwise renders him incapable in order to evade military service or other military obligation shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.

Force against a military person in the performance of military duty

## 363. člen

(1)	Whoever by force or threat to use force directly prevents a military person from performing military duty or in the same manner compels him to perform military duty shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.
(2)	Attempt is punishable.
(3)	If the perpetrator, in committing the act referred to in the first paragraph of this Article, insults a military person, treats him badly or inflicts a minor bodily injury on him or threatens him with the use of a weapon, he shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(4)	If the perpetrator of the act referred to in the first to third paragraphs of this Article was provoked by unlawful or cruel treatment by a military person, he shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment of up to six months, but the penalty may also be remitted.

Attack on a military person performing service

## 364. člen

(1)	Whoever attacks or seriously threatens to attack a military person performing service shall be punished by imprisonment of up to two years.
(2)	If the perpetrator, in the act referred to in the preceding paragraph, threatens a military person with a weapon, treats him badly or inflicts a minor bodily injury on him, he shall be punished by imprisonment of up to three years.
(3)	The penalty referred to in the preceding paragraph shall apply to whoever commits the act referred to in the first paragraph of this Article against two or more military persons.

Negligent handling of means of defence
